title.zh-TW: Linux 啟動崩潰已修好
title.en: Startup crash fixed on affected Linux distributions

body.zh-TW: 剛把 Claude Code 開起來卻立刻關掉，連畫面都還沒來得及用嗎？這個啟動時崩潰的問題，已在採用 glibc 2.44（Linux 程式共用的基礎函式庫）的 Linux 發行版修好。Arch Linux、CachyOS 與 Fedora Rawhide 都是更新說明點名的例子；若你使用其中之一，現在可以再試著啟動。⟦這像門鎖明明配了正確的鑰匙，門卻在轉開前自己彈回；門鎖修好後，鑰匙便能把門打開。⟧
body.en: Does Claude Code close as soon as you try to open it, before you can even use the window? That startup crash is fixed for Linux distributions using glibc 2.44 (a shared foundation library for Linux programs). Arch Linux, CachyOS, and Fedora Rawhide are the examples named in the update, so users of those distributions can try starting it again. ⟦It is like a door lock that springs back just before a matching key can turn; after the lock is repaired, the key can open the door.⟧

items.original: Fixed a crash on startup on Linux distributions that ship glibc 2.44 (for example Arch Linux, CachyOS and Fedora Rawhide)

entries: Added a Loops breakdown to `/usage`: per-loop run count, total tokens, tokens per run, and last run, so runaway or chatty `/loop` tasks are easy to spot

Added `modelPricing` managed setting so an organization's contracted per-model rates and discount multiplier are used for `/cost`, the status line, and telemetry cost figures instead of list price

Fixed MCP server sign-in started from the desktop app failing with "Invalid redirect URI" on servers that support client ID metadata documents (for example Linear)
Fixed auto mode staying unavailable at startup when a temporary server-side disable was cached and later flag fetches failed
Fixed auto mode tool calls being denied as "temporarily unavailable" after about a minute of waiting when the API was briefly overloaded and asked the client to retry
Fixed the `/model` picker silently ignoring an Ultracode selection; picking Ultracode now applies it to the current session
Fixed `/resume` only listing the 50 most recent sessions; the picker now loads more as you scroll
Fixed cloud sessions resuming after a mid-turn restart with a pending hook or background-task notification re-sent as the prompt instead of the normal continuation message
Fixed cross-session messaging silently turning off inside user namespaces and rootless containers after the 2.1.232 socket-directory hardening
Fixed text that hangs outside its container (for example the sign-in URL in `/login`) losing its leading columns when another part of the screen repaints
Fixed `spellcheck` not underlining a misspelled word typed directly after an emoji
Fixed background subagents not waking when their last background Bash task completes
Fixed sessions going silent for 10+ minutes when the Anthropic API never starts a response: the request now times out after ~3 minutes, retries once, then shows `API Error: No response from API`
Fixed auth, model-availability, and other client-generated error messages rendering like model output instead of as error lines
Fixed workload identity federation in CI: processes in one job share the exchanged token instead of re-exchanging the single-use token; a rejected exchange fails fast with the server's message
Fixed server-managed `companyAnnouncements` not showing at startup in a session that began with signing in (for example the first launch after `/logout`)
Fixed hook `if` conditions like `Bash(cat *)` firing on unrelated Bash commands when the command contained `$()` or backtick command substitution followed by more arguments
Fixed plugin dependencies declared with a `marketplace` field never resolving when both plugins are loaded together via `--plugin-dir`
Fixed `/reload-plugins` keeping the LSP tool after the last LSP plugin is disabled; it now also warns before an LSP plugin change that would re-read the conversation
Fixed `--agents` silently ignoring invalid JSON or invalid agent definitions; it now exits with a clear error, like `--mcp-config`
Fixed `/status` showing "Found invalid entries in: ." with no filename when `~/.claude.json` has an invalid MCP server entry
Fixed `/clear` removing the `/rename` session name from the prompt bar even though the name was kept for the new session
Fixed Ctrl+R history search and up-arrow history breaking when `~/.claude/history.jsonl` contains a malformed entry
Fixed Ctrl+[ not leaving vim INSERT mode in terminals that encode modified keys (modifyOtherKeys / kitty protocol)
Fixed the local IDE connection being routed through `HTTPS_PROXY` (and sometimes failing) when `localhost` was listed in `NO_PROXY` but not lowercase `no_proxy`; both casings are now honored
Fixed sandbox network-violation details being dropped from the Bash tool result when the blocked command still exited 0 (for example `curl` printing the proxy's 403 page)
Fixed the status line `rate_limits` fields and `/usage` still showing a rate-limit window's pre-reset usage percentage after the window reset while the session was idle
Fixed `claude --teleport <session>` exiting on uncommitted changes instead of offering to stash them and continue, as the session picker already does
Fixed `/web-setup` repeatedly asking you to log in when an older GitHub CLI (without `gh auth token`) was already authenticated
Fixed Claude in Chrome losing its connection to Claude Code after an auto-update cleaned up the version it was set up with; the native host now launches via the stable `claude` launcher
[VSCode] Fixed sessions started before feature flags were first fetched (for example right after install) opening in the default permission mode instead of auto mode or your configured default mode
[VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded collapsing on their own during subagent tool activity
Improved startup time: sandbox and MCP bring-up no longer block the first frame, bare launches skip subcommand registration, and workflow discovery, settings, and trust-store work is cheaper

Improved attribution of usage telemetry to your organization for sessions that authenticate with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` directly against the Anthropic API, so its data-handling settings apply

Improved the notice when resuming a conversation whose Remote Control is held by another terminal: it now says sessions on other machines can't be seen from, or reach, this one

[VSCode] Improved attribution of the extension's own usage telemetry to your organization when you are signed in with a Claude account, so its data-handling settings apply

title.zh-TW: /usage 新增循環用量拆解，閒置喚醒自動摺疊
title.en: /usage adds Loops breakdown, with idle wake-ups folded cleanly

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像保全巡邏打卡鐘，如果保全每隔一段時間只是路過且一切正常，打卡記錄會自動摺疊成單一行，不必在記錄簿上印出滿滿的重複字句。⟧ 當你在終端機使用 `/loop` 執行循環任務時，系統現在能更清楚掌握執行細節。輸入 `/usage` 指令會顯示全新的 Loops 拆解資訊，列出每個循環的執行次數、總 token（計費與計量文字單位）、每次平均 token 與最後執行時間，方便你一眼揪出暴衝或過度頻繁的循環任務。此外，當 `/loop` 連續喚醒卻沒有任何待辦事項時，終端機會把這些無事可做的喚醒紀錄摺疊成單一行，不再頻繁洗版。
body.en: ⟦Like a security patrol clock where routine passes with nothing to report collapse into a single line instead of filling up the entire logbook.⟧ When running recurring tasks with `/loop`, monitoring execution details is now much easier. Running `/usage` introduces a dedicated Loops breakdown that details per-loop run counts, total tokens, tokens per run, and the last run timestamp, making it easy to spot runaway or chatty tasks. Furthermore, consecutive wake-ups where Claude has nothing to do are now folded into a single terminal line instead of printing every single empty turn.

items.original:
Added a Loops breakdown to `/usage`: per-loop run count, total tokens, tokens per run, and last run, so runaway or chatty `/loop` tasks are easy to spot
Improved `/loop`: consecutive wake-ups where Claude has nothing to do now fold into a single line in the terminal instead of printing each one

title.zh-TW: 模型選單支援自訂排序，雲端平台指令即刻生效
title.en: Customizable model picker ordering, with instant commands on cloud platforms

body.zh-TW: 你現在能隨心所欲整理模型清單了。在設定檔加入 `modelPicker` 設定，即可自訂 `/model` 挑選器中的模型順序與標籤，甚至支援 Vertex 與 Bedrock 的自訂模型識別碼，可選擇附加在內建清單後或直接完全取代。在挑選器中選取 Ultracode 也已修復，會確實套用至當前工作階段（session）。模型挑選器與內建的 `claude-api` 技能同步更新，將 Sonnet 5 每百萬 token 為 2 與 10 美元的定價標示為標準牌價，而非限時優惠。此外，在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或關閉遙測的環境下，輸入 `/model`、`/fast` 與 `/effort` 指令會立即執行，不再排隊等待當前回合結束。⟦這宛如餐廳換上自訂特選菜單，顧客點選招牌菜能立即備餐，省去在點餐機前久候的時間。⟧
body.en: You can now curate your model lineup exactly as you prefer. Adding the `modelPicker` setting lets you customize the `/model` picker with an ordered, labeled list of models (supporting any identifier spelling, including Vertex and Bedrock IDs), either appended to or replacing the built-in selection. Selecting Ultracode in the picker is also fixed and now applies directly to the current session. The picker and bundled `claude-api` skill show Sonnet 5's $2/$10 per Mtok pricing as standard list price rather than a temporary promotion. Furthermore, `/model`, `/fast`, and `/effort` execute immediately on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or when telemetry is disabled instead of queueing until the turn ends. ⟦Like a customized cafe menu where signature selections are prepared immediately without waiting for the ordering queue to flush.⟧

items.original:

Fixed the `/model` picker silently ignoring an Ultracode selection; picking Ultracode now applies it to the current session
Updated the `/model` picker and the bundled `claude-api` skill to show Sonnet 5's $2/$10 per Mtok pricing as its standard list price rather than a limited-time promo
Changed `/model`, `/fast`, and `/effort` to also run immediately instead of queueing until the turn ends on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry and when telemetry is disabled

title.zh-TW: 提示詞快取存活期獨立設定，主對話延長一小時
title.en: Independent prompt cache TTL controls for main sessions and subagents

body.zh-TW: ⟦如同辦公室的公文歸檔，主桌面上的重要專案資料可以常駐保留 1 小時暫存，而隨手派發給跑腿小幫手的臨時便條紙則只暫存 5 分鐘。⟧ 現在使用 API 金鑰或雲端平台提供者的人，能獨立控制快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）的存留時間了。系統新增了 `promptCacheTtl` 與 `subagentPromptCacheTtl` 設定項目，讓你在主要對話中維持長達 1 小時的提示詞快取以節省重算開銷，同時讓短暫運作的子代理維持 5 分鐘快取，精準控制資源配置。
body.en: ⟦Like an office filing system where active master files stay accessible on the desk for 1 hour while transient errand notes expire after 5 minutes.⟧ Users connecting via API keys or cloud providers can now independently configure prompt caching lifetimes. The newly added `promptCacheTtl` and `subagentPromptCacheTtl` settings allow you to keep a 1-hour prompt cache on the main conversation to minimize redundant processing, while keeping short-lived subagents on a 5-minute cache to balance storage costs.

items.original: Added `promptCacheTtl` and `subagentPromptCacheTtl` settings so API-key and cloud-provider users can keep a 1-hour prompt cache on the main conversation while subagents stay at 5 minutes

title.zh-TW: 企業受管定價計算真實成本，來源優先級清楚標記
title.en: Contracted model pricing in cost estimates, with clear managed settings sources

body.zh-TW: 企業內部統一派發設定時，費用計算與設定來源變得更加透明。管理者現在可透過受管設定配置 `modelPricing`。這讓 `/cost` 指令、狀態列（status line，終端機最底下那行即時資訊）與遙測費用統計直接採用公司合約中的個別模型單價與折扣乘數，不再只顯示公開牌價。輸入 `/status` 時新增了 `Skipped sources` 資訊行，清楚列出雖然存在（例如 `managed-settings.json`）但因較高優先級來源生效而未被採用的設定檔。而在 `/mcp` 與 `/plugins` 清單中，由組織統一管理身分驗證的 claude.ai 連接器也會加上 `managed` 標記。⟦如同企業員工憑合約特約享有專屬折扣，報銷清單上能清楚查驗計費來源與派發標記。⟧
body.en: Enterprise configuration distribution and cost tracking are now much more transparent. Organizations can configure the `modelPricing` managed setting. This allows `/cost`, the status line, and telemetry metrics to reflect custom contracted rates and discount multipliers instead of public list prices. Running `/status` now includes a `Skipped sources` line that explicitly enumerates managed configuration files (such as `managed-settings.json`) that are present but ignored due to higher-precedence sources. Additionally, claude.ai connectors in `/mcp` and `/plugins` whose authentication is managed by your organization are clearly badged with a `managed` tag. ⟦Like corporate employees receiving contracted enterprise discounts, with expense logs clearly itemizing policy sources and authentication badges.⟧

items.original:
Added `modelPricing` managed setting so an organization's contracted per-model rates and discount multiplier are used for `/cost`, the status line, and telemetry cost figures instead of list price
Added a `Skipped sources` line to `/status` that lists managed settings sources (for example `managed-settings.json`) present but not applied because a higher-precedence managed source is active
Added a `managed` marker in `/mcp` and `/plugins` on claude.ai connectors whose authentication is managed by your organization

title.zh-TW: 免金鑰 Console 帳號登入，SSH 網址複製與公告修復
title.en: Keyless Console sign-in option, with polished SSH login and announcements

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像大樓訪客登記處，員工只要出示總部工作證就能直接感應通關，不必每次手動填寫臨時通行金鑰。⟧ 登入驗證流程有了諸多貼心改善。現在執行 `/login` 前往 Anthropic Console 時，新增了免金鑰的「使用 Console 帳號登入」建議選項，方便禁止建立 API 金鑰的企業員工快速登入。透過 SSH 遠端連線登入時，登入網址會立即顯示，按下鍵盤 `c` 鍵會誠實回報網址如何複製而非一律回傳成功，全螢幕模式下也會附帶選取文字的提示。此外，登入網址等超出容器邊界的文字不會在畫面重繪時遺失前幾欄內容，登入後首度啟動工作階段（session）時由伺服器管理的企業公告 `companyAnnouncements` 也會正常顯示。
body.en: ⟦Like building security granting badge tap access so employees no longer need to write down temporary access codes.⟧ The authentication experience has received multiple refinements. Under `/login` → Anthropic Console, a keyless "Sign in with your Console account" option is now available (and recommended) alongside API key creation, allowing organizations that forbid manual API keys to sign in cleanly. Over SSH, the sign-in URL renders immediately, pressing `c` accurately reports how the URL was copied rather than always claiming success, and fullscreen hints explain how to select text. Long URLs overflowing container boundaries no longer lose their leading columns during repaints, and server-managed `companyAnnouncements` correctly display upon startup right after logging in.

items.original:
Added a keyless sign-in under `/login` → Anthropic Console: "Sign in with your Console account" (recommended) alongside creating an API key, so organizations that don't allow API keys can sign in
Fixed text that hangs outside its container (for example the sign-in URL in `/login`) losing its leading columns when another part of the screen repaints
Fixed server-managed `companyAnnouncements` not showing at startup in a session that began with signing in (for example the first launch after `/logout`)
Improved `/login` over SSH: the sign-in URL appears immediately, pressing `c` reports how the URL was copied instead of always claiming success, and a hint explains how to select text in fullscreen

title.zh-TW: 網頁版 GitHub 狀態即時檢查，舊版工具驗證相容
title.en: GitHub connection status for web sessions, with legacy GitHub CLI support

body.zh-TW: 在網頁版使用 Claude Code 搭配 GitHub 專案時，連線狀態一目了然。針對尚未為網頁版綁定 GitHub 的 claude.ai 使用者，系統會主動跳出提示引導你前往 `/web-setup` 進行設定。在狀態列（status line，終端機最底部的即時狀態行）輸入 `/status`，現在會明確標示 Pro 或 Max 方案在網頁版的 GitHub 連線狀態，未連線時也會附上 `/web-setup` 連結。此外，如果你的電腦上安裝的是尚未支援 `gh auth token` 的舊版 GitHub CLI（GitHub 命令列工具），`/web-setup` 不會再因為讀不到該指令而無限次重複要求你重新登入。⟦此舉有如儀表板上的連線檢測燈號，主動指引尚未驗證的通訊線路並相容既有的舊款通行證。⟧
body.en: Connecting web-based Claude Code sessions to your GitHub repositories is now much smoother. For claude.ai users who haven't yet linked GitHub for Claude Code on the web, a helpful tip guides you directly to `/web-setup`. Checking `/status` displays a dedicated line showing whether GitHub is connected for your Pro or Max web workspace, pointing you to `/web-setup` whenever it isn't. Furthermore, running `/web-setup` no longer gets stuck repeatedly demanding logins when an older GitHub CLI installation without the `gh auth token` command is already authenticated. ⟦Like a dashboard status light that points out unlinked communication channels while remaining fully compatible with older security badges.⟧

items.original:
Added a tip pointing claude.ai users who haven't connected GitHub for Claude Code on the web to `/web-setup`
Added a `/status` line showing whether GitHub is connected for Claude Code on the web (Pro/Max), pointing to `/web-setup` when it isn't
Fixed `/web-setup` repeatedly asking you to log in when an older GitHub CLI (without `gh auth token`) was already authenticated

title.zh-TW: 子代理運行模型透明化，背景任務喚醒與視圖修復
title.en: Subagent model and effort visibility, with reliable wake-up and view persistence

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像工地的派工白板，看板上明確標註每位副手使用的是哪一款精密機具與出力等級。⟧ 派遣子代理處理任務時的狀態掌握度更上一層樓。現在輸入 `/tasks` 或打開代理詳細對話框時，清單會明確列出每個子代理運行的模型名稱以及思考努力等級（effort level）。如果背景子代理正在等待它指派的最後一個背景 Bash 指令執行，系統修復了指令完成後子代理未被喚醒的狀況，現在會如期接續後續工作。在 VSCode 編輯器中，你在 Focus 視圖中手動展開的區塊，也不會再因為子代理頻繁呼叫工具而被強制自動摺疊收合。
body.en: ⟦Like a workshop job board detailing the specific machinery and effort ratings assigned to each technician.⟧ Inspecting subagent tasks is now far clearer. Running `/tasks` or opening subagent detail dialogs explicitly displays the exact model and effort level assigned to each agent. When background subagents run long Bash jobs, an issue where agents failed to wake after their final background task completed has been resolved, ensuring uninterrupted workflow continuations. In VSCode, sections you manually expand inside the Focus view will no longer spontaneously collapse whenever subagents execute background tools.

items.original:
Added the model (and effort level) each subagent ran on to `/tasks` and the agent detail dialogs
Fixed background subagents not waking when their last background Bash task completes
[VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded collapsing on their own during subagent tool activity

title.zh-TW: 遠端外部工具斷線自動重連，桌面授權與錯誤排除
title.en: Remote MCP reconnection in headless runs, with desktop auth and status fixes

body.zh-TW: 連接外部工具時的穩定性大幅提升。在非互動 `-p` 模式或透過 SDK 呼叫時，遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若遇到網路斷線，現在會自動嘗試重新連線。重試失敗後系統會明確回報錯誤，工作階段（session）不再永久失聯。針對支援用戶端中繼文件之服務如 Linear，修正了從桌面版應用程式啟動 MCP 登入時跳出重新導向網址無效的錯誤。若使用者的 `~/.claude.json` 設定檔中包含格式錯誤的 MCP 伺服器項目，輸入 `/status` 時會清楚印出出錯的檔案路徑，不再顯示缺少檔名的空白提示。⟦類似重要專線遇到線路瞬斷時會主動自動重撥，通訊錄遇到錯誤條目也會精確指明檔案位置。⟧
body.en: Connecting to external tools via MCP is now significantly more dependable. In non-interactive `-p` runs and SDK sessions, dropped connections to remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers now automatically reconnect or report an explicit failure instead of silently hanging. For services supporting client ID metadata documents such as Linear, MCP server sign-in initiated from the desktop application no longer fails with an invalid redirect URI error. Additionally, when `~/.claude.json` contains a malformed MCP server configuration, `/status` explicitly prints the offending filename instead of displaying an unhelpful dot without a path. ⟦Like a dedicated hotline automatically redialing dropped lines while misconfigured address books cleanly point to the exact file requiring attention.⟧

items.original:
Fixed remote MCP servers in non-interactive (`-p`) and SDK sessions never recovering after a dropped connection; they now reconnect automatically or report as failed
Fixed MCP server sign-in started from the desktop app failing with "Invalid redirect URI" on servers that support client ID metadata documents (for example Linear)
Fixed `/status` showing "Found invalid entries in: ." with no filename when `~/.claude.json` has an invalid MCP server entry

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集相依性正確解析，重載語言工具安全預警
title.en: Marketplace plugin dependency resolution, with LSP reload warnings

body.zh-TW: 開發自訂外掛（plugin）時的除錯體驗更為流暢。當你透過 `--plugin-dir` 參數同時載入多個外掛時，修正了宣告 `marketplace` 欄位的外掛相依性永遠無法解析的問題，現在本機相依套件能正常關聯。執行 `/reload-plugins` 指令時，若停用了最後一個支援 LSP（語言伺服器協定，提供程式碼定義跳轉與補全的服務）的外掛，系統會確實卸除殘留的 LSP 工具。同時，若外掛變更會引發重新讀取整個對話紀錄，指令會在執行前主動跳出安全警告，避免讀取流程被無預警中斷。⟦彷彿工具箱在更換模組時能正確卡緊相依配件，並在卸下舊工具或重整抽屜前主動發出提醒。⟧
body.en: Plugin development and lifecycle management are significantly more dependable. When loading multiple local plugins together via `--plugin-dir`, dependencies declaring a `marketplace` field now resolve smoothly rather than failing indefinitely. Running `/reload-plugins` properly removes the LSP (Language Server Protocol) tool once the final LSP-providing plugin is disabled. Additionally, if an LSP plugin modification requires re-reading the entire conversation history, the command proactively surfaces a warning before proceeding. ⟦Like a modular toolbox locking interdependent attachments into place while warning you before reorganizing entire drawers.⟧

items.original:
Fixed plugin dependencies declared with a `marketplace` field never resolving when both plugins are loaded together via `--plugin-dir`
Fixed `/reload-plugins` keeping the LSP tool after the last LSP plugin is disabled; it now also warns before an LSP plugin change that would re-read the conversation

title.zh-TW: 自動模式暫存鎖死修復，過載等候與初始權限修正
title.en: Auto mode transient lockup fixes, overload retry, and VSCode launch defaults

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像車輛的自動巡航功能，不會因為先前路況管制快取了暫存停用標記，就在路況恢復後繼續把功能鎖死。⟧ 讓 Claude 自行執行任務的自動模式（auto mode，讓 AI 不逐一詢問就自主執行工具的模式）修復了多項卡住問題。以前若伺服器端曾暫時停用該功能並被暫存，後續特徵旗標抓取失敗時會導致自動模式永久不可用，現已排除此問題。當 API 短暫過載並要求重試時，自動模式呼叫工具在等候約 1 分鐘後不會再被錯誤判定為暫時無法使用而直接拒絕。在 VSCode 擴充套件中，剛安裝完成或尚未抓取特徵旗標前啟動的工作階段（session），也會正確採用你自訂的預設模式或自動模式，不再強制退回預設權限模式。
body.en: ⟦Like a vehicle cruise control system recovering promptly after a temporary road closure instead of remaining permanently locked out.⟧ Auto mode (where Claude acts without prompting for approval on every action) has received critical reliability fixes. If a temporary server-side disable was cached, subsequent feature flag fetch failures will no longer keep auto mode permanently disabled at startup. When the API experiences brief overload and requests client retries, tool calls in auto mode will no longer be rejected as "temporarily unavailable" after waiting about 1 minute. In VSCode, sessions started before feature flags finish their initial fetch (such as immediately after installation) now cleanly open in auto mode or your configured default mode rather than falling back to default permission prompts.

items.original:
Fixed auto mode staying unavailable at startup when a temporary server-side disable was cached and later flag fetches failed
Fixed auto mode tool calls being denied as "temporarily unavailable" after about a minute of waiting when the API was briefly overloaded and asked the client to retry
[VSCode] Fixed sessions started before feature flags were first fetched (for example right after install) opening in the default permission mode instead of auto mode or your configured default mode

title.zh-TW: 歷史工作階段無限滾動，暫存傳送與通知修復
title.en: Infinite scrolling for session picker, with teleport stash prompts

body.zh-TW: 接續過往對話的操作體驗更為順暢。輸入 `/resume` 挑選歷史對話時，清單不再受限於最近 50 個工作階段（session），現在只要向下捲動就會持續載入更多對話記錄。當你使用 `claude --teleport <session>` 指令傳送至其他工作階段時，若當前目錄有未提交的程式碼變更，系統會主動詢問是否將變更放入 stash 暫存並繼續，不再直接退出程式。針對雲端工作階段，在對話中途重啟後，若有未完成的掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）或背景任務通知，系統會以正常的接續訊息送出，不會再誤把通知內容當成使用者的提示詞。⟦這好比翻閱無限延伸的檔案抽屜，在跨機器搬移文件前主動提示將未歸檔草稿放入暫存夾。⟧
body.en: Picking up past conversations is now much smoother. Running `/resume` is no longer capped at displaying the 50 most recent sessions; scrolling down continuously fetches older conversations. When running `claude --teleport <session>` with uncommitted git changes, the CLI prompts to stash your changes and proceed rather than abruptly exiting. In cloud environments, sessions resuming after a mid-turn restart now send pending hook or background task notifications as regular continuation messages instead of mistaking them for user prompts. ⟦Like browsing through an expandable filing drawer that safely stashes draft notes into temporary storage before moving across desks.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/resume` only listing the 50 most recent sessions; the picker now loads more as you scroll
Fixed cloud sessions resuming after a mid-turn restart with a pending hook or background-task notification re-sent as the prompt instead of the normal continuation message
Fixed `claude --teleport <session>` exiting on uncommitted changes instead of offering to stash them and continue, as the session picker already does

title.zh-TW: 終端機歷史搜尋防毀損，對話改名與按鍵修正
title.en: Terminal history resilience, session title preservation, and keybinding fixes

body.zh-TW: 命令列介面的各項互動細節獲得全面修復。輸入 `/clear` 清除對話畫面時，先前透過 `/rename` 設定的自訂工作階段（session）名稱會完整保留在提示列中，不再意外消失。當歷史檔 `~/.claude/history.jsonl` 中混入損毀項目時，按 Ctrl+R 搜尋歷史或按方向鍵上鍵不會再崩潰中斷，能穩定瀏覽其他指令。在支援特殊按鍵編碼（例如 modifyOtherKeys 或 kitty 協定）的終端機裡，修正了按 Ctrl+[ 無法退出 Vim 插入模式的問題。此外，緊接在 Emoji 表情符號後方輸入的錯字，拼字檢查 `spellcheck` 現在也能正確標上紅色底線。⟦其概念有如翻開厚實筆記本抽換內頁時，封面標籤依然完好留存且自動跳過字跡破損的歷史頁面。⟧
body.en: Everyday terminal interactions are now significantly more reliable. Running `/clear` preserves your renamed session title in the prompt bar for the new session instead of dropping it. When `~/.claude/history.jsonl` contains a malformed entry, searching history via Ctrl+R or pressing the up-arrow no longer breaks command browsing. Terminals that encode modified keys (such as modifyOtherKeys or kitty protocol) now properly exit Vim INSERT mode when pressing Ctrl+[. Furthermore, `spellcheck` accurately underlines misspelled words typed immediately following an emoji. ⟦Like swapping pages in a binder while keeping drawer labels intact and gracefully skipping over torn historical notes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `spellcheck` not underlining a misspelled word typed directly after an emoji
Fixed `/clear` removing the `/rename` session name from the prompt bar even though the name was kept for the new session
Fixed Ctrl+R history search and up-arrow history breaking when `~/.claude/history.jsonl` contains a malformed entry
Fixed Ctrl+[ not leaving vim INSERT mode in terminals that encode modified keys (modifyOtherKeys / kitty protocol)

title.zh-TW: 容器跨工作階段通訊修復，收件通訊端逾時釋放
title.en: Cross-session messaging in rootless containers, with socket idle timeouts

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像大樓住戶專用的對講機系統，即使住戶身處非 root 獨立隔間內也能正常通話，且佔線超過 30 秒未說話就會自動切斷以釋放線路。⟧ 多對話協作的通訊管道現在更穩健了。在 2.1.232 版進行通訊端資料夾強化後，使用者命名空間與無 root 容器內的跨工作階段（session）傳訊功能曾被默默關閉，這次修復徹底解決了此問題。同時，跨工作階段收件匣的通訊端（socket）機制加入防護，若連線進入後在 30 秒內未傳送任何完整的行，系統會自動中斷該連線，因此發送資料的腳本應在資料準備完畢後再建立連線。
body.en: ⟦Like an apartment intercom allowing residents in isolated rooms to communicate freely while hanging up on lines that stay silent for 30 seconds.⟧ Inter-session communication is now significantly more dependable. Following directory security hardening in version 2.1.232, cross-session messaging that silently disabled itself inside user namespaces and rootless containers has been restored. Furthermore, the cross-session inbox socket now closes any connection that fails to send a complete line within 30 seconds, so custom scripts should connect only when payloads are ready to transmit.

items.original:
Fixed cross-session messaging silently turning off inside user namespaces and rootless containers after the 2.1.232 socket-directory hardening
Changed the cross-session messaging inbox socket to close connections that send no complete line within 30 seconds; scripts posting to it should connect once their data is ready

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控環境中斷自動恢復，跨機器提示更清晰
title.en: Remote Control environment auto-recovery, role fixes, and cross-machine notices

body.zh-TW: 遠端操控對話時的連線韌性顯著提升。當伺服器在中途遺失環境時，執行 `claude remote-control` 不會再直接退出而丟下連線中的遠端工作階段（session），現在具備自動恢復機制。針對非管理員或擁有者角色的 Team 與 Enterprise 團隊成員，修正了停止並重啟 `claude remote-control` 後工作階段偶爾卡死的問題。此外，當你嘗試接續一個遠端遙控權限正被其他終端機佔用的對話時，提示訊息現在會清楚說明其他機器上的工作階段無法看見或連線至當前機器。⟦這相當於遠端連線基地台在伺服器重開時能自主重連，並在控制權被佔用時清楚標示跨機器隔離。⟧
body.en: Remote session control is significantly more resilient against network interruptions. When a server drops its environment mid-session, `claude remote-control` automatically recovers instead of exiting and stranding attached sessions. For Team and Enterprise members without admin or owner roles, sessions served by `claude remote-control` no longer get stuck after being stopped and restarted. When resuming a conversation currently locked by another terminal, the prompt explicitly informs you that sessions on other machines cannot be viewed from or reach your current host. ⟦Like a remote base station that automatically reconnects after dropouts while clearly warning when another terminal holds active control.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude remote-control` exiting and stranding attached Remote Control sessions when the server drops its environment mid-session; it now recovers
Fixed Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` sometimes getting stuck after it was stopped and restarted, for Team and Enterprise members without an admin or owner role
Improved the notice when resuming a conversation whose Remote Control is held by another terminal: it now says sessions on other machines can't be seen from, or reach, this one

title.zh-TW: 沙盒主動嘗試外連請求，代理大小寫相容與違規攔截
title.en: Sandboxed Bash network requests on demand, proxy casing, and violation logs

body.zh-TW: 在受管網路環境下使用沙盒（sandbox）執行指令時，連線判斷更為靈活。沙盒環境中的 Bash 工具提示詞不再預先列出所有允許的網域清單，讓 Claude 能主動發起網路請求，方便你在執行當下核准新主機，避免 AI 預設未列出的主機皆被封鎖而直接放棄。當被攔截的指令依然回傳成功代碼 0 時（例如 `curl` 印出代理伺服器的 403 錯誤頁面），工具執行結果不會再遺漏沙盒的網路違規細節。此外，本機 IDE 連線現在同時相容大寫 `NO_PROXY` 與小寫 `no_proxy` 設定，避免本機連線誤走代理伺服器。⟦正如警衛室不再預先封閉未登記的訪客通道，而是允許訪客提出申請並由管理員當場核准放行。⟧
body.en: Network handling inside the execution sandbox is now much more flexible. The sandboxed Bash tool prompt no longer pre-lists allowed hosts, encouraging Claude to attempt requests so you can approve new domains on the fly instead of having the model assume unlisted hosts are blocked. When a blocked command exits with code 0 (such as `curl` outputting a proxy 403 page), the full network violation details are preserved in the tool results. Furthermore, local IDE connections now honor both uppercase `NO_PROXY` and lowercase `no_proxy` environment variables to prevent local traffic from routing through HTTP proxies. ⟦Like a checkpoint guard allowing visitors to request entry for live supervisor approval rather than turning everyone away at the gate.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the local IDE connection being routed through `HTTPS_PROXY` (and sometimes failing) when `localhost` was listed in `NO_PROXY` but not lowercase `no_proxy`; both casings are now honored
Fixed sandbox network-violation details being dropped from the Bash tool result when the blocked command still exited 0 (for example `curl` printing the proxy's 403 page)
Changed the sandboxed Bash tool prompt to no longer list allowed network hosts, so Claude attempts requests (and you can approve new hosts) instead of assuming unlisted hosts are blocked

title.zh-TW: 伺服器無回應三分鐘自動重試，錯誤排版與限流重置
title.en: Three-minute API timeout with auto-retry, clean error lines, and usage refresh

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像撥打客服專線，若對方線路完全無聲，系統在約 3 分鐘後會主動重試一次，確定無回應便明確顯示錯誤訊息。⟧ 遭遇網路異常與額度重置時的體驗變得更加可靠。以前當 Anthropic API 完全沒有啟動回應時，工作階段（session）可能會陷入 10 分鐘以上的漫長無聲等待；現在請求會在約 3 分鐘後自動逾時並重試 1 次，若依然無回應則明確顯示 `API Error: No response from API`。驗證失敗、模型無法使用等用戶端產生的錯誤訊息，現在會以標準的錯誤行格式顯示，不再被誤渲染成 AI 的回覆文字。此外，當工作階段在閒置期間跨過限流視窗重置時間點，狀態列（status line，終端機最底部的即時狀態行）與 `/usage` 不會再殘留重置前的舊使用量百分比。
body.en: ⟦Like a phone call that redials once after 3 minutes of dead silence and clearly reports the issue if the line remains dead.⟧ Handling API dropouts and rate limits is now much more predictable. If the Anthropic API never begins streaming a response, requests no longer sit silent for 10+ minutes; they now time out after ~3 minutes, retry once, and surface `API Error: No response from API` if unresolved. Client-generated error messages (such as authentication or model availability errors) render as explicit error lines instead of normal model output. Furthermore, idle sessions accurately reset the status line `rate_limits` and `/usage` percentages once windows reset.

items.original:
Fixed sessions going silent for 10+ minutes when the Anthropic API never starts a response: the request now times out after ~3 minutes, retries once, then shows `API Error: No response from API`
Fixed auth, model-availability, and other client-generated error messages rendering like model output instead of as error lines
Fixed the status line `rate_limits` fields and `/usage` still showing a rate-limit window's pre-reset usage percentage after the window reset while the session was idle

title.zh-TW: CI 環境共享授權令牌，用量遙測精確歸屬組織
title.en: Workload identity token sharing in CI, with enterprise telemetry attribution

body.zh-TW: 在持續整合（CI）與企業環境中執行時，身分驗證與用量歸屬更加完善。在 CI 的工作負載身分同盟環境下，同一個作業中的多個處理程序現在會共用已兌換的 token（授權令牌）。系統不會再因重複兌換單次有效的令牌而導致失敗，若兌換遭拒也會直接顯示伺服器回傳的錯誤訊息以便快速排除。針對直接使用 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` 向 Anthropic API 進行身分驗證的工作階段（session），其使用量遙測數據現在會正確歸屬至你的所屬組織，落實企業的資料處理政策。在 VSCode 中使用 Claude 帳號登入時，擴充套件本身的用量遙測也同步套用該歸屬規則。⟦這如同出差團隊共用同一張換領證明完成各項任務，並將所有公務開銷精確歸戶至所屬部門。⟧
body.en: Automated CI workflows and organization telemetry tracking have been significantly upgraded. Under workload identity federation in CI pipelines, multiple processes within a single job now share the exchanged token instead of attempting to reuse a single-use token. Rejected exchanges fail fast alongside informative server messages. For sessions authenticating directly against the Anthropic API using `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, usage telemetry is accurately attributed to your organization so its data-handling policies apply. In VSCode, extension telemetry similarly routes to your organization when signed in via a Claude account. ⟦Like a field crew sharing a single master entry voucher while all corporate expense logs route directly to company accounts.⟧

items.original:
Fixed workload identity federation in CI: processes in one job share the exchanged token instead of re-exchanging the single-use token; a rejected exchange fails fast with the server's message
Improved attribution of usage telemetry to your organization for sessions that authenticate with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` directly against the Anthropic API, so its data-handling settings apply
[VSCode] Improved attribution of the extension's own usage telemetry to your organization when you are signed in with a Claude account, so its data-handling settings apply

title.zh-TW: 啟動加速免等外部工具，下載瘦身與記憶體隨選載入
title.en: Instant startup skipping MCP blocks, zstd binary compression, and on-demand memory

body.zh-TW: 啟動速度與記憶體佔用迎來全方位瘦身優化。現在啟動時不再被沙盒與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）初始化卡住首頁畫面，直接啟動會跳過子指令註冊，設定檔與工作流的讀取也變得更輕量。安裝檔與自動更新改採 zstd 壓縮，以 Linux x64 為例下載體積從原本的 340 MB 大幅縮減至約 75 MB；內建技能與提示詞經過壓縮後，原生二進位檔體積也縮減約 2 MB。在執行階段，程式碼改為隨選載入而非全部常駐記憶體。每個工作階段（session）約可節省 40 至 70 MB 記憶體，長久運作時也會在堆疊增長時提早進行垃圾回收以降低峰值用量。⟦這好比跑車全面進行輕量化改裝，既縮減零件體積也只在需要時調用模組以節省引擎負擔。⟧
body.en: Startup speed and memory footprints have been thoroughly optimized. Startup no longer blocks its initial frame on sandbox and MCP bring-up, bare launches skip subcommand registration, and settings or trust-store lookups are significantly lighter. Installation and auto-update downloads now use zstd compression, shrinking the Linux x64 binary download from ~340 MB down to ~75 MB, while compact prompt storage shaves ~2 MB off the final binary. During execution, code loads on demand rather than keeping the entire bundle resident. Each session saves roughly 40–70 MB memory, and garbage collection triggers earlier in long sessions to tame peak heap memory. ⟦Like a sports car undergoing comprehensive weight reduction, minimizing package sizes and engaging auxiliary components only when needed.⟧

items.original:
Improved startup time: sandbox and MCP bring-up no longer block the first frame, bare launches skip subcommand registration, and workflow discovery, settings, and trust-store work is cheaper
Improved native install and auto-update download size: the binary is now zstd-compressed (about 75 MB instead of 340 MB on Linux x64)
Improved native binary size: about 2 MB smaller by storing the bundled skill and prompt text more compactly
Improved memory usage of native builds: code is now loaded on demand instead of keeping the whole bundle resident (roughly 40–70 MB less memory per session)
Improved peak memory usage in long-running sessions (the runtime now garbage-collects sooner as the heap grows)

title.zh-TW: 代理定義格式嚴格驗證，指令替換與思考層級修正
title.en: Strict agent definition validation, hook substitution, and thinking effort fixes

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像海關申報檢查，若旅客遞交了格式毀損或無法辨識的文件，查驗窗口會直接退回並清楚指出格式錯誤，不再假裝沒看見。⟧ 命令列參數與自動化規則的防呆驗證全面收緊。使用 `--agents` 參數啟動時，若傳入無效的 JSON 或格式錯誤的代理人定義，程式不再默默略過，而是會像 `--mcp-config` 一樣立即印出明確錯誤並退出。在掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）條件中，修正了類似 `Bash(cat *)` 的判斷條件在遇到包含 `$()` 或反引號指令替換時誤觸發不相干指令的問題。此外，若在關閉思考功能的狀態下設定了 `xhigh` 或 `max` 思考等級，錯誤訊息會明確指出該等級名稱、是哪項設定關閉了思考，並提示改用 `/effort high` 解決。
body.en: ⟦Like an official checkpoint rejecting malformed paperwork with clear instructions rather than waving invalid documents through.⟧ Command line inputs and automation rules now feature stricter validations. When launching with `--agents`, malformed JSON or invalid agent definitions will no longer be silently ignored; the CLI exits immediately with a descriptive error, matching `--mcp-config`. Hook `if` conditions like `Bash(cat *)` no longer mistakenly fire on unrelated commands containing `$()` or backtick substitutions. Additionally, setting effort levels to `xhigh` or `max` while thinking is disabled triggers a clear error naming the configured level, the offending setting, and `/effort high` as the fix.

items.original:
Fixed hook `if` conditions like `Bash(cat *)` firing on unrelated Bash commands when the command contained `$()` or backtick command substitution followed by more arguments
Fixed `--agents` silently ignoring invalid JSON or invalid agent definitions; it now exits with a clear error, like `--mcp-config`
Improved the error when effort `xhigh`/`max` is used with thinking turned off: it now names the level, the setting that disabled thinking, and `/effort high` as the fix

title.zh-TW: macOS 桌面點擊授權，瀏覽器連線與長對話歷史保留
title.en: macOS desktop Finder permissions, Chrome reconnects, and VSCode history trimming

body.zh-TW: 跨平台與編輯器整合的各項操作體驗更為穩固。在 macOS 上使用電腦操作（computer use）功能時，點擊桌面、Dock 應用程式列或 Finder 視窗現在需要透過存取對話框授予 Finder 權限，符合一般應用程式的安全授權規範。針對 Chrome 瀏覽器外掛整合，修復了自動更新刪除舊版本後導致瀏覽器與 Claude Code 連線中斷的問題，原生連線程式現在改透過穩定的 `claude` 啟動器載入。在 VSCode 長時間對話的工作階段（session）中，修剪過長歷史紀錄時會優先移除舊的工具操作細節，確保你的訊息與 Claude 的回覆文字持續完整可見。⟦如同辦公大樓嚴格控管各處出入口授權，長久對話記錄也能妥善去蕪存菁以保留核心發言。⟧
body.en: Desktop integrations and extension reliability have been polished. On macOS, computer use actions that click the desktop, Dock, or Finder windows now explicitly require granting Finder permission via the system access dialog, aligning with standard application security policies. In the Claude in Chrome extension, connection drops caused by auto-updates cleaning up past binaries are resolved by having the native messaging host launch through the stable `claude` launcher. In VSCode long sessions, history trimming prioritizes dropping older tool-activity rows first, ensuring your prompts and Claude's replies remain visible. ⟦Like an office building managing access checkpoints while archiving historical meeting transcripts by pruning routine logs to preserve key statements.⟧

title.zh-TW: 預算估算納入美區溢價，額度耗盡立即停損
title.en: Budget estimates include US inference premium, with immediate stop on quota depletion

body.zh-TW: 你設定了預算上限，卻老是抓不準何時該停手或何時額度重設。現在輸入 `/cost`、查看狀態列或指定 `--max-budget-usd 10.0` 旗標時，針對有資料落地限制的工作區，系統會將僅限美國推論的 1.1 倍加成自動計入花費預估。當月度花費額度耗盡時，用量上限提示現在會同步標明你的工作階段（session）或每週額度何時重置。若你開啟了持續重試模式 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG=1`，一旦遇到組織花費上限或額度用光，程式會立即失敗結束，不會再無休止地空等重設。VSCode 橫幅裡的查看用量按鈕也調整至警示文字同一行。⟦這好比智慧電表不僅在計費時把尖峰加成算得一清二楚，在用電超標時也會列出各項額度何時重置，遇到總開關跳電時更會果斷切斷供電，不再讓電器徒勞空轉。⟧
body.en: When setting strict budgets, knowing exactly what you are spending and when limits reset is essential. Now when running `/cost`, checking the status line, or passing `--max-budget-usd 10.0`, workspaces with data residency requirements automatically factor in the 1.1× US-only inference surcharge. If your monthly spend limit is reached, the warning dialog explicitly tells you when your session or weekly limit resets. Furthermore, persistent retry mode with `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG=1` now exits immediately on organization spending caps or out-of-credit errors rather than waiting forever. The "View usage" button in VSCode has also been shifted inline with the alert text. ⟦Like a smart power meter that factors in peak-hour tariffs, shows exact recharge times when quota runs out, and immediately trips the main circuit breaker during a blackout to keep appliances from running idle.⟧

title.zh-TW: 代理伺服器計費防重複，Bedrock 與網頁連線更穩
title.en: Proxy billing duplication fixed, stabilizing Bedrock and web connections

body.zh-TW: 在公司內部網路透過代理伺服器使用 Claude 時，連線與計費更加可靠。以前在 Bedrock 平台後方遇到移除回應標頭的代理伺服器，系統會誤以為串流（streaming）失敗而私下以非串流重跑，造成 API 計費莫名翻倍；現已修正。同時，若在 Bedrock 搭配 SSO 與 `awsAuthRefresh`，啟動前的憑證（credentials）預先檢查現在會遵循 `export HTTPS_PROXY="http://proxy.corp.com:8080"` 代理變數，解決卡死問題。在網頁版工作階段中，來自 Bash 等工具前往 non-API 網域的請求也會正確走代理連線，落實網域白名單。⟦如同貨物經由海關通道進出，通道剝掉標籤不會被重複扣稅，人員換證走專用窗口，確保物流全在許可路徑通行。⟧
body.en: Connecting through corporate proxies to reach Claude is now much safer and smoother. Previously, when using Bedrock behind proxies that stripped response Content-Type headers, the client mistakenly assumed streaming failed and secretly re-ran turns non-streaming, silently doubling API costs; this double-billing glitch is now completely resolved. Furthermore, when using Bedrock with SSO profiles and `awsAuthRefresh`, startup credential checks properly honor `export HTTPS_PROXY="http://proxy.corp.com:8080"`, eliminating startup freezes. In web sessions, requests from Bash or other tools to non-API anthropic.com domains also route through the session proxy to enforce organizational allowlists. ⟦Like goods moving through a customs transit corridor — stripped shipping labels won't trigger duplicate clearance tariffs, inspectors use dedicated checkpoint lanes for credential renewal, and all traffic remains strictly within approved channels.⟧

Claude Code on the web: requests from Bash and other tools to non-API anthropic.com hosts (e.g. www, docs) now go through the session's network proxy, so your environment's allowed domains apply

title.zh-TW: 隊友上線名單一覽無遺，Windows 跨工作階段通訊
title.en: Teammate visibility in agent lists, with cross-session messaging on Windows

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像拿對講機呼叫隊友時，通話機上會清楚顯示自己的呼號，螢幕也能列出頻道內所有在線的隊員，就算隊呼開頭帶有斜線符號也不會變成幽靈人口。⟧ 現在多代理人（agent）協作的通訊機制全面完善。執行 `ListAgents` 或輸入 `/list-agents` 時，清單中會列出所有在線的活隊友，不再像以往只顯示子代理與其他工作階段而漏掉身旁隊友。工作階段（session）現在能透過 `ListAgents` 獲知同儕用來聯絡自己的名稱；若誤向自己發送 `SendMessage`，系統會明確提醒那是你自己的名字，而非回報找不到該對象。此外，標題以 `/` 開頭的工作階段不再顯示為無標題且可正常通訊，Windows 平台也正式支援跨工作階段傳訊，跨機器協作與 macOS 及 Linux 同步。
body.en: ⟦Like using a walkie-talkie channel where your radio screen clearly badges your own callsign and lists every active teammate on the frequency, without turning slash-prefixed names into ghosts.⟧ Multi-agent coordination and session messaging are now fully refined. Running `ListAgents` or typing `/list-agents` displays active teammates alongside subagents and other sessions, so reachable peers never look absent. A session now discovers its own peer-facing address via `ListAgents`, and sending a `SendMessage` to your own name explicitly informs you that it is yourself rather than claiming the agent does not exist. Titles starting with `/` are no longer rendered as "(untitled)" or broken in routing, and Windows users now enjoy cross-session messaging on equal footing with macOS and Linux.

title.zh-TW: 長期任務背景防打擾，目標還原與容器保活
title.en: Non-intrusive background goals, with goal restoration and container keep-alive

body.zh-TW: 把耗時的任務交給背景執行，你不再需要被頻繁的打擾打斷工作節奏。現在使用 `/goal` 執行長任務時，簽到間隔會逐步拉長，從 30 分鐘延長至 1 小時，之後每 2 小時一次，不再每半小時重複打擾。若你透過 `claude --resume` 挑選並接續工作階段（session），系統會自動還原該對話中進行中的活躍目標。針對遠端與雲端工作階段，在執行耗時的 `SessionStart` 或 `Setup` 掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）期間會持續發送保活訊號，防止容器在掛鉤執行途中被當成閒置而回收。此外，閒置背景工作者重啟後也能穩定維持原有的計畫模式。⟦這好比參加長途耐力賽，沿途補給站會隨著賽程拉長而自動拉開打卡間距避免打擾跑者，選手暫停回帳棚休息後重返賽道依然能接續目標，後勤車輛也持續回傳心跳訊號防止被判定棄賽。⟧
body.en: Running background tasks no longer interrupts your workflow with non-stop pings. When using `/goal` for long-running jobs, check-in prompts now back off progressively (from 30 minutes, to 1 hour, to every 2 hours) instead of constantly buzzing you every 30 minutes. Resuming a session with `claude --resume` automatically restores its active goal. For remote and cloud sessions, executing lengthy `SessionStart` or `Setup` hooks (scripts triggered on events) continuously sends keep-alive heartbeats to keep the hosting container from being reaped mid-hook. Cloud workers restarting after being idle also cleanly preserve their active plan mode. ⟦Like an endurance marathon where checkpoint staff space out check-ins to let runners focus, returning athletes seamlessly resume their course targets, and support vans transmit steady heartbeats to prevent accidental disqualification.⟧

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控標題同步限流，手機傳圖與分頁清理
title.en: Remote Control sync rate-limiting, mobile image paths, and Chrome cleanup

body.zh-TW: 當你用手機或遠端遙控操控電腦上的 Claude 時，多裝置協作變得更穩定。現在當兩個處理程序共用同一個背景任務狀態時，遠端遙控的標題同步會自動去重並進行速率限制，解決標題瘋狂洗版的問題。透過手機上傳至遠端工作階段（session）的圖片，現在會附帶本機儲存檔案路徑，讓 Claude 能直接將圖片複製進新建立的檔案中。如果你的帳號尚未開通 Remote Control 功能，終端機與 `claude doctor` 會顯示更清晰易懂的診斷說明。此外，在 Chrome 瀏覽器整合中，輸入 `/clear` 會關閉該工作階段的分頁群組，執行 `/resume` 或結束程式時也會順手清理空白群組。⟦這有如跨國團隊共用的遠端戰情白板，兩地同時更新進度時不再瘋狂閃爍洗版，隊員隨手從手機上傳的現場照片會清楚標記檔案櫃編號，下班或清空白板時也會順手把用完的暫存便籤整組撕除。⟧
body.en: Controlling Claude from your mobile device or via Remote Control is significantly more polished. When two processes share a background task, title synchronizations to Remote Control are deduplicated and rate-limited to stop runaway loops. Images uploaded from mobile into remote sessions now include their saved local file paths, enabling Claude to copy them directly into newly created project files. When Remote Control is not enabled for your account, `claude doctor` provides much clearer guidance. Additionally, in Chrome integration, running `/clear` closes the session's tab group, while `/resume` and clean exits tidy up lingering empty groups. ⟦Like a shared international war room whiteboard where simultaneous updates stop flickering, mobile field photos carry exact folder index tags, and clearing the desk wipes away all transient sticky notes.⟧

title.zh-TW: 自訂對話標題長久留存，路徑識別與目錄容錯
title.en: Session titles preserved past 64KB, with smart path matching and deleted directory fallback

body.zh-TW: 辛辛苦苦為對話取了自訂名稱，卻在聊了幾輪後突然在清單裡找不到。這次修復了多項接續工作階段（session）的歷史紀錄問題。以前為對話改名後只要後續對話超過約 64 KB，自訂標題就會在 `/resume` 選單中消失，即使後續對話超過約 64 KB，標題仍會留在 `/resume` 清單中。使用 `claude -c` 或接續功能時，路徑若僅有底線、連字號或點號等符號差異，系統不再錯誤抓取其他資料夾的對話。只是重新開啟對話或檔案被外部觸碰，不會再被誤判為最近更新而擾亂排序。在全專案模式下，若對話原本的工作目錄（例如已被刪除的工作樹副本）已不存在，系統會直接在當前目錄接續，不再叫你切換進不存在的資料夾。⟦就像辦公室的檔案櫃，抽屜上的自訂標籤不會因為文件越塞越厚而脫落，翻閱檔案時不會把順序弄亂，即使原本歸檔的辦公桌拆除了，也能就地在手邊的桌面攤開繼續處理。⟧
body.en: Naming your conversations keeps your workspace organized, but long sessions used to lose their custom titles. Renaming a session now keeps its title in `/resume` even after the conversation grows beyond ~64 KB. Path matching in `claude -c` and `/resume` properly distinguishes directories that differ only by `_`, `-`, or `.` separators instead of accidentally loading foreign chats. Merely touching or reopening a session file no longer falsely marks it as updated or disrupts its display order. In all-projects mode, if a session's previous directory (such as a removed worktree) no longer exists, Claude resumes safely in your current directory rather than asking you to `cd` into a ghost folder. ⟦Like an office filing cabinet where drawer labels stay firmly attached as folders grow thick, casual browsing never scrambles alphabetical order, and dismantled desks let you open files on your current tabletop.⟧

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕支援雲端平台，焦點防誤觸與深色對比
title.en: Fullscreen mode on cloud platforms, focus misclick protection, and dark theme contrast

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像走進升級後的巨幕影廳，剪票員只在進場時貼心引導座位且三次無人回應就自動安靜，觀眾轉頭拿爆米花點擊螢幕聚焦時也不會誤觸緊急按鈕。⟧ 全螢幕模式（fullscreen mode）的初次體驗與操作細節迎來重要修正。在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 等以往排除的雲端平台上，現在也會提供單次全螢幕提示，新安裝環境更會預設直接以全螢幕啟動。如果終端機環境無法回應全螢幕提示，系統在連續提示 3 次後便會自動停止詢問，不再每次啟動都跳出提示洗版。當終端機視窗失去焦點時，你隨手點擊視窗切換焦點，不會再誤按授權提示或送出按鈕。而在深色主題 `dark-ansi` 下，全螢幕展開工具結果時文字顏色與背景同色的對比度問題也已徹底排除。
body.en: ⟦Like entering a modern IMAX theater where ushers guide you to prime seats and quiet down after three unanswered prompts, and refocusing your view never triggers an accidental button press.⟧ Fullscreen terminal rendering is now much smoother across Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and previously excluded setups. Setups on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and previously excluded environments now receive the one-time fullscreen offer, with fresh installs defaulting to fullscreen. If your terminal cannot answer the setup prompt, the inquiry automatically ceases after three launches rather than nagging indefinitely. Clicking into an unfocused terminal window only restores focus and no longer accidentally submits permissions or activates interactive buttons. Under the `dark-ansi` theme, expanded tool output text is no longer rendered invisibly in the same color as the background.

items.original:
Added the one-time fullscreen renderer offer on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other previously excluded setups; new installs there now start in fullscreen
Fixed the `dark-ansi` theme rendering expanded tool results in fullscreen mode with text the same color as the background
Fixed the fullscreen renderer prompt reappearing on every launch when it could never be answered; it now stops after being shown on three launches
Fixed fullscreen mode answering a permission prompt or pressing a button when you clicked the terminal window only to bring it back into focus

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕表單支援捲動，面板與對話框排版修復
title.en: Scrollable fullscreen forms, pinned panels, and workflow dialog fixes

body.zh-TW: 在全螢幕下叫出長表單或設定面板，常遇到按鈕被邊界切斷或擋住最新對話。現在全螢幕模式下的視窗排版與彈跳對話框變得更清晰。當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的互動表單高度超出終端機視窗時，表單會自動縮放貼合視窗，隱藏欄位可透過捲動瀏覽，而接受與拒絕按鈕會固定在底部始終可見。輸入 `/config` 或 `/model` 等斜線指令叫出設定面板時，對話內容會保持固定在面板上方，不再被面板直接遮蔽。此外，在 Claude 正在輸出回覆時打開 `/workflows` 工作流詳細對話框，視窗也不會再超出終端機而導致標頭被擠出螢幕外。⟦這如同影廳側邊浮現的互動控制面板，長條選單能隨意上下滾動且底部的確認與取消鍵永遠置頂可見，彈出設定表單時也不會硬生生遮住正在播放的主畫面。⟧
body.en: Opening tall forms or configuration panels in fullscreen mode no longer clips essential buttons or buries recent messages. When an MCP elicitation form exceeds terminal height, it neatly fits the viewport with scrollable fields while the Accept and Decline buttons remain pinned and visible at all times. Slash-command panels like `/config` and `/model` keep the active conversation pinned above them instead of covering your latest messages. Opening the `/workflows` dialog while Claude is actively streaming a response also properly constrains window dimensions, ensuring dialogue headers never scroll out of view. ⟦Like an on-screen interactive control panel where long option menus scroll freely, confirmation buttons stay firmly anchored, and settings overlays never obscure the main show playing behind them.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP elicitation forms taller than the terminal being clipped in fullscreen mode: the form now fits the window, with hidden fields reachable by scrolling and Accept/Decline always visible
Fixed slash-command panels (e.g. `/config`, `/model`) in fullscreen mode covering the latest messages; the conversation now stays pinned above the panel
Fixed the `/workflows` detail dialog overflowing the terminal and losing its header off-screen when opened while Claude is still responding

title.zh-TW: Readline 快速鍵對齊 Bash，文字選取與搜尋修復
title.en: Readline keybindings align with Bash, fixing text selections and search deletion

body.zh-TW: 習慣終端機快速鍵的開發者，現在游標移動與編輯更順手。在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 加入 `{"keybindingFlavor": "readline"}` 後，單字跳轉與刪除（Alt+F、Ctrl/Option+→、Alt+D，可用 Ctrl+Y 貼回）對齊 Bash 並以標點分詞。搜尋框按 Ctrl+Backspace 改為刪除單字。Shift 延伸選取後 `selection:copy` 不再漏字。游標在 `[Pasted text #N]` 內以 Ctrl+W、Ctrl+U、Ctrl+K、Option+Backspace、Option+D 或 vim `df`/`dt` 刪除不留損毀片段。代理人視圖 vim 模式按 Escape 切回 NORMAL 模式並保留輸入。⟦猶如鋼琴家在琴鍵上滑音，跳轉精準停在音符上，剪下片段不漏音也不破壞樂譜。⟧
body.en: Terminal power users will find cursor navigation and line editing much more natural. Configuring `{"keybindingFlavor": "readline"}` in `~/.claude/settings.json` matches Bash word manipulation exactly: Alt+F and Ctrl/Option+→ jump to word boundaries, Alt+D deletes forward to word ends (restorable with Ctrl+Y), and punctuation acts as word dividers. In search boxes, Ctrl+Backspace deletes entire words instead of single characters. Text selections extended with Shift+Arrow keys are reliably grabbed by `selection:copy`. Deleting text with Ctrl+W, Ctrl+U, Option+Backspace, Option+D, or vim `df`/`dt` while inside `[Pasted text #N]` placeholders no longer leaves corrupted placeholder markers. In agent view with vim mode active, pressing Escape switches cleanly to NORMAL mode while preserving typed text. ⟦Like a pianist gliding effortlessly across familiar keys — navigation stops precisely on each intended note, while copying phrases or cutting bars preserves every musical notation without missing a beat.⟧

items.original:
Fixed vim mode in the agent view: Escape now switches to NORMAL mode and keeps your text instead of clearing the prompt
Fixed the `selection:copy` keybinding silently dropping a text selection that had been extended with Shift+Arrow keys
Fixed Ctrl+W, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K, Option+Backspace, Option+D and vim `df`/`dt` leaving a broken `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder when the cursor was inside it
Fixed Ctrl+Backspace deleting one character instead of a word in search boxes
`keybindingFlavor: "readline"` now also matches Bash for word keys: Alt+F and Ctrl/Option+→ stop at the end of the word, Alt+D deletes to it (Ctrl+Y pastes it back), and punctuation separates words

title.zh-TW: 密碼輸入防外洩，過濾瀏覽器終端滑鼠雜訊
title.en: Masked input leak protection and browser terminal mouse noise filtering

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入登入驗證碼或移動滑鼠時，敏感字串與雜訊字元容易意外洩漏或干擾輸入欄位。以前在密碼遮罩輸入框中輸入的敏感文字，若按兩次 Esc 清除，可能會殘留在歷史紀錄或被 Ctrl+Y 意外貼出；現在機密文字已被嚴格隔離。在瀏覽器型終端機中，滑鼠移動回報若分段寫入，曾會將 "35;150;7M" 等座標字串誤塞進提示欄，現已全面過濾乾淨。⟦這好比在提款機輸入密碼時上方加裝了防窺遮光罩，按完清除鍵後不會在暫存剪貼簿留下痕跡，滑鼠在螢幕旁晃動也不會誤輸入雜訊代碼。⟧
body.en: Entering credentials or moving the mouse in web terminals used to risk leaking sensitive secrets or injecting stray text. Masked fields like login verification codes no longer leak into prompt history or let cleared secrets be pasted via Ctrl+Y after double-pressing Esc. Browser-based terminals no longer leak fragmented mouse tracking strings like "35;150;7M" into your input prompt when mouse reports arrive across multiple writes. ⟦Like a secure ATM keypad fitted with an anti-peeping shield, where clearing credentials leaves no trace in the clipboard buffer and moving your hands nearby never injects stray sensor codes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed mouse movement in browser-based terminals inserting text like `"35;150;7M"` into the prompt when a mouse report arrived split across writes
Fixed masked (password-style) inputs such as the login code field letting their text be pasted back with Ctrl+Y elsewhere or saved to prompt history when cleared with double Esc

title.zh-TW: Shell 模式補全保留路徑前綴，腳本執行零阻礙
title.en: Shell mode Tab completion preserves `./` path prefixes

body.zh-TW: 當你在命令列前加上驚嘆號切換至 Shell 模式（以 `!` 開頭），並按下 Tab 鍵補全本機腳本路徑時，指令能直接正確執行。以前輸入 `./script` 並按 Tab 鍵進行自動補全時，系統會自動剔除前方的 `./` 前綴，導致補全後的指令因為缺少當前目錄路徑而無法被 Shell 辨識與執行；現在補全時會完整保留 `./` 標記。⟦如同在快遞包裹上填寫收件地址時，自動校正地址會完整保留代表同一社區的門牌前綴，快遞員不會因缺少起點標記而找不到門牌。⟧
body.en: When switching to shell mode with an exclamation mark (`!`) and pressing Tab to autocomplete executable scripts, commands now execute seamlessly. Previously, Tab completion on a `./script` path dropped the leading `./` prefix, leaving a bare command name that the underlying shell could not resolve or run; completion now faithfully retains `./`. ⟦Like an address autocompletion system that keeps local neighborhood district prefixes intact on package labels, ensuring delivery couriers can find local destinations immediately.⟧

items.original: Fixed shell-mode (`!`) Tab completion dropping the `./` from a `./script` path, which left a command the shell couldn't run

title.zh-TW: 外掛雲端同步獨立管理，市集根目錄設定生效
title.en: Cloud plugin synchronization isolation and marketplace plugin root resolution

body.zh-TW: 在雲端與本機同步外掛時，套件管理變得井然有序。在雲端工作階段（session）中，由 claude.ai 同步的外掛會明確標記為 `name@synced`，你可以透過 `claude plugin enable <name>@synced` 或 `claude plugin disable <name>@synced` 獨立開關，且永不覆蓋本機自行安裝的同名外掛。此外，在外掛市集設定 `{"metadata": {"pluginRoot": "packages"}}` 後，純外掛來源名稱會如說明文件所述正確解析至該子目錄下。⟦如同工匠專屬工具箱，從總部借來的公用工具會貼上專用標籤獨立收納，不僅能各自獨立取用，也絕不會覆蓋自己手邊同名的私家工具。⟧
body.en: Managing plugins across local environments and cloud accounts is now completely conflict-free. In cloud sessions, plugins synced from claude.ai are designated with a `name@synced` suffix, can be independently controlled with `claude plugin enable <name>@synced` or `claude plugin disable <name>@synced`, and will never overwrite local custom plugins sharing the same name. In plugin marketplaces, configuring `{"metadata": {"pluginRoot": "packages"}}` now properly resolves bare package source names under that subdirectory as documented. ⟦Like a master craftsman's portable toolbox where company-issued loaner tools carry clear identification tags, allowing independent toggling without ever replacing favorite personal tools.⟧

items.original:
Cloud sessions: plugins synced from claude.ai now show as `name@synced`, work with `claude plugin enable/disable <name>@synced`, and never override a same-named plugin you installed
Fixed marketplace `metadata.pluginRoot` having no effect: bare plugin source names now resolve under it as the docs describe

title.zh-TW: 遠端 MCP 伺服器短暫中斷自動復原，連線更穩固
title.en: Remote MCP servers automatically recover from transient 5xx reconnect errors

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像天文觀測站與遠端望遠鏡連線時，偶爾遭遇大氣干擾造成短暫訊號中斷，在線路恢復後系統會自動重新連線，不會讓昂貴的儀器永久停擺。⟧ 遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的容錯與連線穩定度大幅提升。以前在雲端工作階段中途重連，或是透過 SDK 的 `setMcpServers()` 動態更新伺服器清單時，若遠端 MCP 伺服器遭遇短暫的 5xx 伺服器錯誤，連線會永久卡死在失敗狀態；現在連線重試修復後能順暢復原並繼續提供服務。
body.en: ⟦Like an astronomical observatory communicating with a remote telescope where brief atmospheric interference never permanently severs the telemetry link once the weather clears.⟧ Remote MCP (protocols connecting AI to external tools) servers recover gracefully from transient connection drops. When reconnecting mid-session in cloud environments or reconfiguring servers dynamically via the SDK's `setMcpServers()`, encountering a momentary 5xx server error no longer leaves the remote MCP server permanently broken; it automatically recovers and resumes tool availability.

items.original: Fixed remote MCP servers staying failed after a transient 5xx on a mid-session reconnect in cloud sessions or via SDK `setMcpServers()`

title.zh-TW: 工作樹沙盒相容修復，目錄刪除容錯與規則排除
title.en: Worktree sandbox fixes, missing directory fallback, and symlink exclusions

body.zh-TW:
清理暫存目錄或設定 Git 排除規則時，路徑問題不再使程式崩潰。從已刪除目錄啟動 Claude Code 會印出清晰診斷。工作階段（session）目錄若途中遭刪除，系統不再當機。掛鉤（hook，觸發的小程式）改由專案根目錄或家目錄執行，避免 ENOENT 錯誤。在 Git 工作樹（worktree，平行副本）中，`.worktreeinclude` 以 `**/` 開頭的規則能正常比對已忽略資料夾內的檔案；在設定 `extensions.worktreeConfig` 的儲存庫中，Linux 沙盒不再因缺少 `.git/config.worktree` 使 Git 指令失效。若在設定檔加入：
```
{"claudeMdExcludes": [".claude/rules"]}
```
無論指向規則目錄或符號連結（symlink，捷徑檔）本身皆能排除。⟦如同大型工地拆除臨時通道時自動導向空地，標籤無論標記捷徑或入口皆能引導工人避開管制區。⟧
body.en:
Cleaning up temporary project directories or managing complex Git ignore patterns is now error-free. Launching Claude Code from a deleted working directory prints a helpful diagnostic message instead of throwing an unhandled stack trace. If the session working directory disappears mid-session, hooks (event-driven helper scripts) automatically fall back to executing from the project root or home directory rather than failing with ENOENT errors. In Git worktrees (parallel repository working copies), `.worktreeinclude` patterns starting with `**/` successfully match paths inside gitignored folders, and in repositories with `extensions.worktreeConfig` set, Linux sandboxes no longer break git commands when `.git/config.worktree` is missing. Adding rule exclusions:
```
{"claudeMdExcludes": [".claude/rules"]}
```
cleanly excludes symlinked rule files when referencing the link name or parent directory. ⟦Like navigating a major construction site where dismantled scaffold walkways automatically guide workers back to safe central plazas, while inspection guides follow detour signs seamlessly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a raw crash dump when starting Claude Code from a directory that no longer exists; it now prints a clear message
Fixed `.worktreeinclude` patterns starting with `**/` silently matching nothing when the target lived in a gitignored directory
Fixed the Linux sandbox making a nonexistent `.git/config.worktree` unreadable, which broke every sandboxed git command in repos with `extensions.worktreeConfig` set
Fixed hooks failing with "posix_spawn ENOENT" after the session's working directory was deleted; they now run from the project root or home directory instead
Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` not excluding a symlinked `.claude/rules` file when the pattern names the rules directory or the symlink rather than its target

title.zh-TW: Python SDK 升級指令上線，自動遷移 1.x 規格
title.en: Automated Python SDK migration to 1.x via `/claude-api upgrade`

body.zh-TW: 升級舊版 Python 專案變得更省時省力。全新加入的 `/claude-api upgrade` 指令能自動將專案中的 `anthropic` SDK 從 0.x 順暢遷移至 1.x 版本，並同步更新技能內的 Python 參考文件與呼叫慣例（例如逾時設定改用 `anthropic.Timeout` 代替舊的 `httpx.Timeout`）。⟦這好比鐵路全面升級高鐵規格時，派出專用的換軌工程車自動調校全線所有車廂的連接規格與轉向架，讓老舊列車迅速適應全新提速標準。⟧
body.en: Modernizing older Python codebases is now straightforward. The new `/claude-api upgrade` command migrates your Python project's `anthropic` SDK from 0.x to 1.x automatically, updating the skill's Python reference and API patterns for 1.x conventions (such as configuring timeouts with `anthropic.Timeout` rather than `httpx.Timeout`). ⟦Like deploying specialized rail-conversion engineering engines during a high-speed network upgrade to adjust every carriage coupling, bringing existing rolling stock up to modern mainline specifications.⟧

items.original: Added `/claude-api upgrade` to migrate Python projects from `anthropic` 0.x to 1.x, and updated the skill's Python reference for 1.x (timeouts use `anthropic.Timeout`, not `httpx.Timeout`)

title.zh-TW: Alpine Linux 原生擴充支援，貼圖剪貼與音訊就緒
title.en: Alpine Linux native add-ons load for clipboard, image paste, and audio

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像為輕量化跑車換上專屬設計的超輕量輪胎，不再因規格不合而被底盤拒於門外，在極限賽道上也能完全發揮各項性能。⟧ 針對採用 musl 標準函式庫的 Alpine Linux 環境，Claude Code 改為載入專屬 musl 編譯二進位模組，徹底解決以往因 glibc 格式不相容而被執行環境拒絕載入的問題。現在輕量容器與 Alpine 系統下，原生圖片貼上、系統剪貼簿讀寫與音訊擷取擴充功能皆能隨開即用。
body.en: ⟦Like outfitting a lightweight racing car with custom lightweight tires tailored specifically for its bespoke chassis, ensuring all peripheral components function smoothly.⟧ In lightweight Alpine Linux environments built on the musl standard C library, Claude Code now loads dedicated musl-compiled native add-ons instead of glibc binaries rejected by the runtime. Developers running inside Alpine containers can now enjoy native clipboard access, native image pasting, and audio capture without compatibility hitches.

items.original: Alpine/musl builds: native image paste, clipboard, and audio-capture add-ons now load (musl-built binaries instead of glibc ones refused by the runtime)

title.zh-TW: UTF-8 BOM 檔案相容，代理人與自訂指令正常載入
title.en: UTF-8 BOM support for agents, skills, and custom commands

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或特定文字編輯器中建立說明文件時，常因隱藏的檔頭標記導致自訂功能無故失效。以前定義代理人（agent）、技能與自訂指令的 `.md` 檔案若開頭包含 UTF-8 BOM，會被系統默默忽略而形同虛設。現在系統能正確辨識這種位元組順序記號並順利載入檔案。⟦如同圖書館掃描器升級後，即使書籍封面印有額外的防偽印記或特殊編碼標籤，也能精準讀取書名並順利歸檔。⟧
body.en: Creating configuration docs in certain text editors often introduces invisible header bytes that caused custom behaviors to fail silently. Markdown `.md` definitions for declarative agents, skills, and custom commands that begin with a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark) were previously ignored without warning. Claude Code now parses and activates them reliably. ⟦Like a library scanner that reads barcodes and titles flawlessly even when book covers feature unusual anti-counterfeiting embossed stamps.⟧

items.original: Fixed agents, skills, and commands whose `.md` file starts with a UTF-8 BOM being silently ignored

title.zh-TW: 啟用語音聽寫不再跳出提示，啟動畫面乾淨無擾
title.en: Startup tip silenced when voice dictation is enabled via settings

body.zh-TW:
開啟語音輸入功能後，終端機啟動畫面變得更清爽。若你已經在設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中加入了以下設定啟用語音聽寫：
```
{"voice": {"enabled": true}}
```
系統啟動時會正確識別你已開啟功能，不會再每次重複跳出無謂的 `/voice` 功能提示與教學。⟦如同舞台上的專業收音麥克風，一旦後台完成通電與靜音指示燈設定，前台螢幕就不會反覆亮起開機教學提示，讓演出流程保持乾淨流暢。⟧
body.en:
Enabling voice dictation now keeps your terminal startup interface clean and uncluttered. If you have already enabled voice dictation by adding the following snippet to `~/.claude/settings.json`:
```
{"voice": {"enabled": true}}
```
Claude Code properly recognizes your configuration on startup, permanently silencing the redundant `/voice` onboarding tip. ⟦Like a professional studio microphone that skips repetitive power-on tutorial overlays once its soundboard switches and mute indicators are configured.⟧

items.original: Fixed the `/voice` startup tip still appearing after voice dictation was enabled via the `voice.enabled` setting

title.zh-TW: `/insights` 深入分析輸出濾除多餘標籤，格式更乾淨
title.en: Clean `/insights` formatting without extraneous XML message tags

body.zh-TW: 當你執行 `/insights` 指令深入分析對話歷史與專案洞察時，產生的報表內容更加乾淨俐落。以前在使用部分模型生成分析結果時，回覆內容中常會夾雜模型輸出的字面 `<message>` 標籤，把報表排版撐得亂七八糟；現在系統會自動把這些標籤濾掉。⟦如同演講者的即時字幕投影，系統會自動濾除演講稿內部的提詞註記與排版符號，讓觀眾看到的螢幕文字始終清晰易讀。⟧
body.en: Running `/insights` to analyze conversation history and generate codebase usage trends now yields cleaner reports. When querying certain underlying models, literal `<message>` tags previously leaked into the generated insights output; they are now stripped before the report is shown. ⟦Like a live speech teleprompter that automatically filters out internal directorial cues and stage annotations, displaying only polished text to the presenter and audience.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/insights` echoing literal `<message>` tags in its response on some models

title.zh-TW: 主題顏色設定全面生效，自訂狀態徽章色彩
title.en: Custom theme color overrides respected for effort and ultracode status badges

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像賽車儀表板允許車手自訂不同轉速與檔位的警示背光色彩，客製化調色能如實呈現，不再被系統預設配色強制覆蓋。⟧ 自訂介面主題的色彩細節獲得了完整支援。以前在終端機主題設定中自訂 effort 或 ultracode 等狀態徽章的顏色時，系統會默默忽略你的設定並維持原廠預設顏色；現在自訂主題覆寫已能被系統精準讀取，並如實套用至各項狀態徽章。
body.en: ⟦Like a performance cockpit where drivers customize dashboard alert backlights to their preferred hues without the factory defaults overriding their choices.⟧ Custom theme styling for terminal badges is now fully supported. Configuration overrides for the effort and ultracode status badge colors were previously ignored by the interface renderer; Claude Code now honors your custom theme colors across all status indicators.

items.original: Fixed custom theme overrides for the effort/ultracode status badge colors being ignored

title.zh-TW: 工具呼叫超長路徑中間省略，終端排版維持單行
title.en: Tool-use rows truncate long file paths in the middle

body.zh-TW: 在深層專案目錄下觀察工具執行狀態時，終端機畫面排版更整齊美觀。當 Claude 呼叫 Edit、View 或 Bash 等工具時，工具使用列若遇到超長的檔案路徑，系統現在會自動在路徑中間加入省略符號（例如 `src/.../utils.ts`）進行截斷，確保整行資訊維持在同一行顯示，不再因路徑過長自動折行而弄亂終端機畫面。⟦如同登機證列印超長姓名時會在中間自動縮寫，既完整保留首尾關鍵字，又確保版面整齊單行不換行。⟧
body.en: Monitoring tool activity in deep directory structures is significantly cleaner. When Claude invokes tools like Edit, View, or Bash, excessively long file paths on tool-use rows are now truncated in the middle with ellipses (such as `src/.../utils.ts`). This ensures tool output rows fit neatly on a single terminal line without awkward line wraps scrambling your display. ⟦Like a boarding pass that abbreviates long middle names while preserving the first and last names, keeping ticket layouts crisp and single-lined.⟧

items.original: Long file paths on tool-use rows now truncate in the middle to stay on one line

title.zh-TW: 請求管線防競態與重送，壓縮提示精準防重複
title.en: Request pipeline race fix, policy resend prevention, and compaction reminder refinement

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像智慧門禁閘門具備防呆機制，刷卡被拒絕時不會重複扣款，取消排隊不會誤判通行，重新感應時也不會重複執行舊指令。⟧ 對話請求管線的多項重複執行問題已全數修復。排隊輸入提示時按 Esc 不再引發競態條件導致工作階段（session）提早閒置而重複執行動作。被組織政策檢查拒絕的請求，不會在顯示拒絕訊息前被錯誤重複發送。對話壓縮後的提示文字也完成改良，避免技能的原始參數被誤當成新請求再次重跑。
body.en: ⟦Like an automated security turnstile with anti-duplicate logic that never debits rejected cards twice, never misinterprets cancelled queues, and prevents old credentials from triggering duplicate entries.⟧ Pipeline execution now cleanly avoids unintended request duplicates. Pressing Esc with a prompt queued no longer triggers a race condition that prematurely idles the session and causes resubmissions to repeat prior actions. Requests rejected by organizational policy checks are no longer re-sent before the rejection reason is displayed. Context compaction reminders have also been updated to ensure skill arguments are not accidentally re-executed as fresh user requests.

items.original:
Fixed a race where pressing Esc with a prompt queued could let the next turn finish early, leaving the session idle while Claude was still working and letting a later resubmit repeat actions
Fixed a request rejected by an organization policy check being re-sent before the rejection was shown
Improved the reminder shown after compaction so a skill's original arguments are not re-run as a new request

title.zh-TW: JetBrains 編輯停頓排除，網頁暫存定時釋放記憶體
title.en: JetBrains terminal edit pauses resolved and WebFetch memory release

body.zh-TW: 在 IDE 內頻繁修改程式碼或透過網頁擷取大量資料時，偶爾會遇到畫面卡住或記憶體持續攀升。在 JetBrains IDE 終端機連線 Claude Code 外掛時，執行 Edit 與 Write 工具時會停頓約 5 秒的卡頓問題已獲得解決。此外，WebFetch 快取（cache，暫存查過的網頁內容）在 15 分鐘後會如預期過期並釋放記憶體。這讓它不再在整個工作階段（session）中持續佔用系統資源。⟦如同辦公桌清理機制，用完的工具不再卡住工作節奏，桌上累積的過期草稿也會定時清空，讓桌面始終保持寬敞。⟧
body.en: Editing files within IDEs and fetching web resources no longer suffers from unexpected pauses or memory leaks. In JetBrains IDE terminals, a 5-second pause during Edit and Write tool calls when connected to the Claude Code plugin has been resolved. Furthermore, WebFetch cache entries properly expire and free up system memory after 15 minutes as intended, rather than hoarding memory for the remainder of the session. ⟦Like clearing off a cluttered desk where tools put away immediately stop stalling work and expired scratch drafts get discarded on schedule to keep the workspace open.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Edit and Write calls pausing for about 5 seconds in JetBrains IDE terminals when the Claude Code plugin is connected
Fixed WebFetch retaining expired page content in memory for the whole session instead of the intended 15 minutes

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤延遲工具延續追蹤，OpenTelemetry 軌跡完整
title.en: OpenTelemetry trace continuity for hook-deferred tool executions

body.zh-TW: 當你在系統中設定攔截掛鉤並使用 OpenTelemetry 監控執行歷程時，遙測數據變得更加完整連貫。以前由 `PreToolUse` 掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發攔截的小程式）延遲執行的工具呼叫，會錯誤開啟一條全新的追蹤鏈，導致遙測軌跡破碎分散；現在這些延遲執行的工具會正確接續回原對話輪次的追蹤歷程中，維持單一連貫的調試軌跡。⟦如同物流轉運時，包裹即使在中途檢查站稍作停留審驗，後續運送仍會沿用原本的轉運單號，讓收件人能從頭到尾完整查詢整個物流履歷。⟧
body.en: Observing tool execution flows with OpenTelemetry while using custom interception hooks is now reliable and unbroken. Previously, tool executions deferred by a `PreToolUse` hook started a brand-new trace, fragmenting telemetry data into disconnected chunks; deferred tool calls now properly resume within the parent turn's original OpenTelemetry trace. ⟦Like package shipping where a parcel held temporarily at a checkpoint resumes transit under its original tracking number, preserving a complete start-to-finish delivery timeline.⟧

items.original: Fixed OpenTelemetry trace fragmentation: tool executions deferred by a `PreToolUse` hook now resume in the original turn's trace instead of starting a new trace
