title.zh-TW: 終端機新增 Readline 按鍵風格，Ctrl+W 可改成刪整詞
title.en: Terminal gains a Readline keybinding flavor for Ctrl+W word deletion

body.zh-TW: 習慣在 Bash 終端機用 Ctrl+W 刪除前一個單字的使用者，現在可在使用者設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 加入 `{"keybindingFlavor": "readline"}` 來切換按鍵風格，讓 Ctrl+W 改成刪到前一個空白為止，跟 Bash 的習慣一致；若不設定，預設的 `"classic"` 模式維持不變。⟦這像替鍵盤換上一份新的操作說明書，同一個按鍵在新說明書裡改成「刪到上一個空格」，沒換說明書的人拿到的還是原本那份，兩種操作互不干擾。⟧
body.en: If you are used to pressing Ctrl+W in Bash to delete the previous word, you can now add `{"keybindingFlavor": "readline"}` to your user settings file at `~/.claude/settings.json` to switch Ctrl+W to delete back to the previous whitespace, matching Bash; the default `"classic"` flavor remains unchanged if you don't set it. ⟦It is like swapping in a new instruction sheet for the keyboard: the same key now means "delete back to the last space" under the new sheet, while anyone who didn't swap sheets keeps the old behavior — the two never interfere.⟧

items.original: Added a `keybindingFlavor` setting: set it to `"readline"` to make Ctrl+W in the prompt delete back to the previous whitespace, as in Bash; the default (`"classic"`) is unchanged

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕回歸純畫面重繪，移除連按清除快捷鍵
title.en: Fullscreen shortcuts focus purely on repainting, and the double-press clear shortcut is removed

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕狀態下的 Ctrl+L 與 Cmd+K 快捷鍵，過去按下後除了重繪畫面，還可能連按兩次觸發 `/clear`（清除對話紀錄），一不小心就把整段對話洗掉。現在這兩個快捷鍵重新聚焦，按下後一律只重繪畫面，連按兩次觸發 `/clear` 的捷徑已移除，同時也解決了單行 nvim 終端機不斷觸發自動清屏迴圈的問題。⟦這讓快捷鍵回歸單純，像黑板擦只負責抹去浮灰顯出字跡，不再因為誤碰兩下就把整面黑板洗白。⟧
body.en: In fullscreen mode, pressing Ctrl+L or Cmd+K used to both repaint the display and, if double-pressed, trigger `/clear`, wiping out the whole conversation by accident. These shortcuts now focus exclusively on repainting the display; the double-press `/clear` shortcut has been removed, and 1-row nvim terminal windows no longer trigger unexpected clear loops. ⟦It keeps shortcut actions predictable, like a chalkboard eraser that only wipes away surface dust without erasing the entire board if tapped twice.⟧

items.original: Changed Ctrl+L and Cmd+K in fullscreen to always just repaint — the double-press `/clear` shortcut was removed, and 1-row nvim terminals no longer trigger automatic `/clear` loops

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集支援動態驗證標頭，安裝前明確提示指令與確認
title.en: Plugin marketplaces gain dynamic auth headers with explicit installation confirmation

body.zh-TW: 外掛（plugin，擴充 Claude 功能的附加元件）市集現在支援更嚴密的動態身分驗證。⟦這好比進出管制大樓，訪客每次換證只拿一張短期有效的臨時感應卡，而且警衛發卡前會先將存取指令攤在桌上請你簽名確認。⟧透過在市集網址或目錄項目設定 `headersHelper`，系統能執行指定指令動態產生 HTTP 標頭，藉由短期 token（授權令牌）安全抓取目錄與同源封存檔。此外，目錄項目的 helper 只會在安裝或更新時執行；`claude plugin install` 與 `update` 會先展示要跑的指令並跳出 `[y/N]` 詢問，你也可以帶 `-y` 參數直接同意。
body.en: Plugin marketplaces now support dynamic authentication. ⟦Like checking into a secure building where visitors receive short-lived access badges, and guards display the requested permissions on a screen before asking for signature approval.⟧ By configuring `headersHelper` on a URL marketplace or catalog entry, the system runs a custom command to mint dynamic HTTP headers, using a short-lived token to fetch catalogs and same-origin archive files. Catalog helpers only execute when installing or updating that plugin after displaying the command, and `claude plugin install` or `update` will prompt with `[y/N]` unless `-y` is passed.

items.original:
Plugin marketplaces: `headersHelper` on a url marketplace or a catalog entry runs a command that mints HTTP headers (e.g. a short-lived token) for catalog and same-origin archive fetches
A catalog entry's `headersHelper` runs only when you install or update that plugin, after its command is shown; `claude plugin install/update` ask `[y/N]` (or pass `-y`)

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器延後關機，輪詢偶失不再誤轉工作階段
title.en: Self-hosted runners defer shutdown and withstand a missed poll

body.zh-TW: 自託管執行器（self-hosted runner，在自己主機上代跑任務的程式）收到 SIGTERM 時，可用 `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>` 指定延後關機。它會繼續服務已連線的工作階段，並在指定分鐘數後將剩餘工作留在待處理狀態，再退出。伺服器也不會只因一次輪詢變慢或遺失，就移除健康的 runner 並將工作階段交給另一個 runner。⟦像交班中的服務櫃檯：先照顧仍在櫃檯前的人，再留下未完事項；對講機一次雜訊不會讓櫃檯被撤掉。⟧
body.en: On SIGTERM, `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>` lets a self-hosted runner keep serving attached sessions, then park remaining work before exiting. A single slow or lost poll request also no longer removes a healthy runner and hands its sessions to another runner. ⟦Like a service desk finishing with people already at the counter; one burst of radio static does not close the desk.⟧

items.original:
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>`: on SIGTERM, keep serving attached sessions, park what is left after that many minutes, then exit
Fixed self-hosted runners occasionally being removed by the server after a single slow or lost poll request, handing their healthy session to another runner

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器支援每次連線更新代理認證
title.en: Self-hosted runners refresh proxy authorization for every connection

body.zh-TW: 若出站代理伺服器每次連線都要求剛簽發的 `Proxy-Authorization` 標頭，現在可使用 `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-command` 或 `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-file` 提供它。這兩個選項讓每次連線取得所需的最新認證標頭，而非沿用前一次資料。⟦像每次寄出掛號包裹都去郵局領取當次的新條碼，不能把上一次的收據貼到這一次包裹上。⟧
body.en: For egress proxies requiring a freshly issued `Proxy-Authorization` header for every connection, self-hosted runners can use `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-command` or `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-file`. ⟦It is like getting a new barcode from the post office for every registered parcel, rather than sticking the last parcel's receipt on this one.⟧

items.original: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --proxy-authorization-command` / `--proxy-authorization-file` for egress proxies that require a freshly issued `Proxy-Authorization` header on every connection

title.zh-TW: 長對話釋放已離開畫面的子代理工具結果
title.en: Long sessions release off-screen subagent tool results

body.zh-TW: 長時間互動時，記憶體不再因子代理工具結果一路累積。結果仍在近期顯示視窗時會留在記憶體中；一旦離開該視窗，系統就會釋放它們，避免長對話出現無上限的記憶體成長。近期顯示視窗內的結果照常可用，釋放的是已不再顯示的工具結果。這個界線會隨顯示內容往前移動。⟦像桌面只攤開正在看的筆記，翻過頁的子任務資料便收回檔案盒，桌面不會被一路堆滿。⟧
body.en: Long sessions no longer keep accumulating memory from subagent tool results. Results remain in memory while in the recent display window, then are released once they leave it, preventing unbounded memory growth. ⟦Like keeping only the notes you are reading on a desk and returning older subtask notes to a file box.⟧

items.original: Fixed unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions: subagent tool results are now released once they leave the recent display window

title.zh-TW: 自訂、專案與外掛輸出風格不再中途回到預設
title.en: Custom, project, and plugin output styles stay in effect

body.zh-TW: 你替 Claude 指定輸出風格時，長對話也會維持那個選擇。自訂、專案和外掛 output styles 過去可能在工作階段中途飄回預設語氣；現在不會再發生。修正涵蓋這三種來源，讓同一場對話不必因為語氣突然改變而重新設定。設定來源雖不同，維持方式相同。⟦像電台主持人全程依照節目選定的口吻播報，不會播到一半忽然換回預設聲線。⟧
body.en: Custom, project, and plugin output styles no longer drift back to the default voice mid-session. ⟦It is like a radio host keeping the programme’s chosen delivery throughout the broadcast.⟧

items.original: Fixed custom, project, and plugin output styles drifting back to the default voice mid-session

title.zh-TW: 權限提示排版支援寬字元與換行，超長網址正常顯示
title.en: Permission prompts handle wide characters, text wrapping, and long URLs correctly

body.zh-TW: 在終端機查看權限確認與差異比對時，排版細節變得更加可靠。過去當 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）跳出輸入對話框時，長度超過 4,096 個字元的網址會直接變成一片空白，現在已經能正常顯示。如果專案路徑太長超出終端機寬度，權限提示也不會再漏掉「不再詢問」的勾選選項。此外，權限提示中的差異對照文字換行也獲得修正，包含 Emoji 在內的寬多碼點字元或 Tab 縮排的長行都不再被裁切。⟦這如同公告欄重新調整了邊界，長路徑與符號都能順暢換行，底下的勾選按鈕也能完整露出來。⟧
body.en: Permission dialogs and diff previews now format text reliably across all terminal sizes. When MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard connecting AI to external tools) opens an elicitation prompt, URLs exceeding 4,096 characters no longer render completely blank. If a project path is wider than your terminal window, the permission prompt will no longer drop the "don't ask again" choice. Furthermore, line wrapping in permission diff views has been fixed so that lines with tabs or wide multi-code-point characters like emoji are never clipped. ⟦Like an adjustable bulletin board that wraps long addresses and symbols cleanly without pushing action buttons off the frame.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP elicitation dialogs showing nothing for URLs longer than 4,096 characters, and permission prompts dropping the "don't ask again" option when the project path didn't fit the terminal width
Fixed text-wrapping in permission prompt diffs: lines containing wide multi-code-point characters (such as emoji) or tabs are no longer clipped

title.zh-TW: 慢速連線倒退鍵不再漏字，強制結束暫停程式游標不失蹤
title.en: Terminal input catches bursty backspaces and restores clean cursor states after Ctrl+Z

body.zh-TW: 在遠端連線或暫停程式時，終端機的輸入反應與畫面狀態現在更乾淨。⟦這好比在訊號顛簸的山路騎車，連續按煞車不會因為網路延遲而遺漏指令，停車拉起手煞車後再啟動，車身也能保持正常狀態。⟧過去在 SSH 或 mosh 等慢速連線上，若終端機將倒退鍵轉為 Ctrl+H，當大量按鍵密集湧入時長按 Backspace 容易被忽略；現在連打輸入已能精準接收。另外，強制結束被 Ctrl+Z 暫停的工作階段時，也不會再發生游標消失且卡在括號貼上模式（bracketed-paste mode）的窘境了。
body.en: Input responsiveness and terminal state cleanup are now reliable over laggy remote connections. ⟦Like riding a bicycle over bumpy terrain where holding the brakes never misses an input, and parking with the handbrake leaves the controls perfectly aligned when resuming.⟧ Previously over high-latency SSH or mosh connections where terminals map Backspace to Ctrl+H, holding down Backspace during keystroke bursts would cause inputs to be dropped; these bursts are now handled accurately. Additionally, killing a session suspended with Ctrl+Z will no longer leave your terminal with a hidden cursor or stuck in bracketed-paste mode.

items.original:
Fixed held Backspace being ignored on terminals that send Ctrl+H for Backspace when keystrokes arrive in large bursts (slow SSH/mosh links)
Fixed killing a suspended (Ctrl+Z) session sometimes leaving the terminal in bracketed-paste mode with the cursor hidden

title.zh-TW: macOS 啟動更迅速，自動檢查更新延後避開 CPU 高峰
title.en: Startup speeds up on macOS, and update checks defer to save CPU

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動工具時，體驗變得更為迅速輕快。針對 macOS 使用者，直接輸入 `claude` 啟動主程式的時間大幅縮短，能更快進入互動提示列。為了讓開啟時的操作更流暢，系統將自動檢查更新的背景排程由程式啟動時改為啟動後約 10 秒才執行，避免在程式剛啟動的關鍵時刻與核心載入程序爭搶 CPU 資源。⟦這就像商店開門營業時先專注招呼剛進門的顧客，等大家入座約 10 秒後，店員才到後台安靜確認進貨更新。⟧
body.en: Launching the tool is now noticeably snappier from the command line. On macOS, running bare `claude` opens the interface significantly faster so you can get straight to work. To keep the app responsive from the very first keystroke, the automatic update check now waits approximately 10 seconds after launch instead of competing with startup routines for CPU cycles. ⟦Like a shopkeeper who prioritizes seating the first guests at the door, waiting about 10 seconds before heading to the back office to review inventory lists.⟧

items.original:
Improved startup: bare `claude` starts sooner on macOS
Improved startup responsiveness: the automatic update check now runs about 10 seconds after launch instead of competing with startup for CPU

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具執行前強制確認目錄信任，移除環境變數憑證繼承
title.en: MCP helpers require folder trust approval and isolate credential environment variables

body.zh-TW: 外部工具的設定執行現在有了更嚴格的安全防護。⟦像餐廳採用新食譜前，主廚先確認可以使用；開始烹調時，前一間廚房的私密調味料不會混進來，而指定食譜只在自己的料理台處理。⟧如果專案的 `.mcp.json` 包含 `headersHelper`，或是專案與 `--add-dir` 代理檔內嵌了 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，現在都必須先通過該資料夾的信任對話框確認，即便在 `claude -p` 非互動模式下也一樣。此外，從專案設定、外掛或代理檔執行的 helper 不再繼承終端機的機密憑證環境變數；而個人、管理與 claude.ai 範圍的 helper 也一律限定在 Claude 設定目錄下執行。
body.en: Security boundaries around external tool configurations have tightened significantly. ⟦Like a restaurant adopting a new recipe only after the head chef approves it: cooking does not bring in private ingredients from another kitchen, and designated recipes are prepared only at their own station.⟧ If a project `.mcp.json` contains `headersHelper`, or if inline MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard connecting AI to external tools) servers exist in project or `--add-dir` agent files, that directory's trust dialog must now be accepted first, even when running non-interactively via `claude -p`. In addition, helpers launched from project files, plugins, or agent configurations no longer inherit credential environment variables, and user, managed, or claude.ai-scoped helpers now run strictly from the Claude config directory.

items.original:
MCP `headersHelper` in a project `.mcp.json`, and inline MCP servers in project or `--add-dir` agent files, now require that folder's trust dialog to have been accepted (also under `claude -p`)
MCP `headersHelper` from a project `.mcp.json`, plugin, or agent file runs without inherited credential env vars; user, managed and claude.ai-scope helpers now run from the Claude config dir

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具延遲載入修復，停用伺服器直接顯示 ⊘ Disabled
title.en: MCP lazy initialization fixed and disabled servers badge as ⊘ Disabled

body.zh-TW: 管理與檢查外部工具時，系統不再打擾處於休眠或停用狀態的伺服器。過去透過 stdio 連線的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器會在收到 `initialize` 初始化請求前，先收到 `server/discover` 探測，導致設計為延遲載入的伺服器在每次開啟工作階段時都被迫提早啟動後端；現在已修正順序。另外，執行 `claude mcp list` 或 `claude mcp get` 查看清單時，已被停用的伺服器會直接標示為 `⊘ Disabled`，不再特地連線進行健康檢查。⟦這如同工具箱裡的備用儀器直接貼上停用標籤，不再每次打開箱子都插電預熱把機器吵醒。⟧
body.en: Inspecting external tools no longer wakes up dormant or disabled services. Previously, stdio MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard connecting AI to external tools) servers received a `server/discover` request before `initialize`, unnecessarily forcing lazy-loaded servers to boot up their backends every time a session opened. This handshake order is now resolved. In addition, `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` now display disabled servers directly as `⊘ Disabled` rather than opening a connection to perform a health check. ⟦Like putting an "out of order" tag on a spare tool in the shed instead of plugging it into the wall to test it every time you open the door.⟧

items.original:
Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving a `server/discover` request before `initialize`, forcing lazy servers to start their backend on every session open
Changed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` to show disabled servers as `⊘ Disabled` instead of connecting to them for a health check

title.zh-TW: Bash 權限判斷理解 zsh 條件式，工作樹不再誤拒絕
title.en: Bash permission checks recognize zsh conditionals and avoid worktree false refusals

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行指令前，Bash 工具的權限檢查現在能正確判讀 zsh 專屬條件判斷式。工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離環境中，沒有重新導向的指令也不會再被誤說成必須移除重新導向。兩項修正分別處理 zsh 條件式與工作樹隔離，避免權限提示錯指問題。⟦像門衛終於看懂不同地區寫法的申請單；表單沒有某欄，就不會要求你劃掉不存在的欄位。⟧
body.en: Bash tool permission checks now evaluate zsh-specific conditional syntax correctly. In isolated git worktrees, commands without a redirect stop receiving false refusals telling you to remove one. ⟦Like a gatekeeper who understands another local form style and does not ask you to cross out a field that is absent.⟧

items.original:
Fixed worktree-isolation Bash refusals telling you to remove a redirect when the command had none
Improved Bash tool permission checking for zsh-specific syntax in shell conditionals

title.zh-TW: 中斷的 Bash 指令不再留下工作目錄暫存檔
title.en: Interrupted Bash commands no longer leave work-directory temp files

body.zh-TW: Bash 指令遭強制終止、超時或中途被中斷時，`/tmp/claude-*-cwd` 不再留下殘餘檔案。這些工作目錄相關的暫存資料，即使指令未正常走到結尾也會被清理。不論哪種中斷原因，後續執行都不會再看見前一個指令留下的這批檔案。清理目標就是該路徑下的工作目錄暫存檔。⟦像臨時工作牌在活動突然取消後仍會收走，不讓下一個人誤以為現場還在使用。⟧
body.en: When a Bash command is killed, times out, or is interrupted, it no longer leaves `/tmp/claude-*-cwd` files behind. These work-directory temporary files are cleaned up even when the command does not finish normally. ⟦Like temporary site signs being removed after an event is suddenly cancelled.⟧

items.original: Fixed leftover `/tmp/claude-*-cwd` files when a Bash command is killed, times out, or is interrupted

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控強化斷線容錯，重試登入且明確點名阻擋代理
title.en: Remote Control bolsters network resilience, retrying sign-ins and naming blocking proxies

body.zh-TW: 遠端遙控在複雜網路環境下的連線韌性大幅增強。代理伺服器拒絕連線時，現在會直接指出該代理伺服器，不再含糊報成一般網路錯誤。另一種情況是網路節點、VPN 或代理伺服器短暫回傳 HTTP 403 拒絕：系統現在最多能容忍等待 3 分鐘並持續重試；若阻擋持續，會直接點名是哪一個拒絕方。如果短暫的網路波動延誤了登入憑證的自動續約，系統會自動重試保持連線，不再動輒中斷並跳出登入過期。此外，使用者手動登出時，也會以明確訊息正常結束工作階段，不再誤報成重連失敗。⟦就像物流員遇上短暫塞車會繼續嘗試送件，若收件櫃檯持續退件，簽收單會寫明是哪個櫃檯拒收。⟧
body.en: Remote Control connectivity is now far more resilient across complex network environments. When a proxy refuses a connection, it now names that proxy rather than returning a generic network error. Separately, when a network edge, VPN, or proxy briefly returns HTTP 403, it tolerates the refusal and retries for up to 3 minutes; if the block persists, it names the refusing party. When a brief network hiccup delays your sign-in credential refresh, the client retries seamlessly instead of abruptly dropping out with "login expired". Signing out also concludes the session cleanly without misreporting a reconnection failure. ⟦Like a courier that keeps attempting delivery through a brief traffic delay and, if a receiving desk repeatedly refuses it, notes exactly which desk turned it away.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a proxy's refusal of a connection being reported as a generic network error instead of naming the proxy
Fixed Remote Control disconnecting with "login expired" when a brief network hiccup delays renewing your sign-in; it now retries and stays connected
Fixed Remote Control reporting a failed reconnect on sign-out; signing out now ends the session with a clear message
Improved Remote Control connection resilience: brief HTTP 403 refusals from a network edge, VPN, or proxy are now tolerated for up to 3 minutes, with the refusing party named when a block persists

title.zh-TW: 遠端選定模型同步終端機，回覆中的新訊息保留逐字稿
title.en: Remote model choices sync to the terminal and mid-turn messages stay in the transcript

body.zh-TW: 你從手機或網頁選擇模型後，終端機顯示的模型現在會同步更新。Claude 正在回覆時，若你從網頁或桌面版送出新訊息，它在回覆結束後也會留在逐字稿中。因此兩個畫面看到的模型選擇與實際對話紀錄能保持一致，不會一邊更新另一邊遺漏。終端機與遠端介面的顯示因此不再脫節。⟦像把手機上的點餐改動傳到廚房看板，同時送出的追加紙條也會留在訂單夾裡。⟧
body.en: A model chosen from a phone or web client now updates the terminal display. A new message sent from the web or Desktop while Claude is mid-turn also remains in the transcript after the turn ends. ⟦Like sending a changed order to the kitchen display while keeping an extra note in the order folder.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control messages sent from the web or Desktop while Claude is mid-turn disappearing from the transcript after the turn finishes
Fixed Remote Control model picks made on a phone or web not updating the model shown in the terminal

title.zh-TW: 遠端任務的 Stop 按鈕現在可停止 CLI 工作階段
title.en: Remote task Stop now works for CLI sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Remote Control 任務面板想停止某個指定工作時，個別 Stop 按鈕如今也能作用於 CLI（命令列介面，透過文字指令操作程式的方式）託管的工作階段。先前按下這個按鈕，CLI 託管的工作階段不會停下來；這項修正讓面板的任務控制能確實傳到它。⟦就像播放清單中按下某首歌旁的停止鍵，只停指定曲目，不必關掉整台播放器或影響其他曲目。⟧
body.en: When you want to stop one named task in the Remote Control panel, its individual Stop button now works for a CLI (command-line interface, a way to operate programs with typed commands) hosted session too. Previously, pressing it left that type of session running; the panel's task control now reaches it. ⟦It is like pressing the stop control beside one song in a playlist: only that track stops, while the player and other tracks remain unaffected.⟧

items.original: Fixed per-task Stop from the Remote Control tasks panel doing nothing on CLI-hosted sessions

title.zh-TW: 無效角色訊息不再讓遠端工作階段退出
title.en: Invalid-role messages no longer end remote sessions

body.zh-TW: 遠端工作階段收到來自用戶端、卻缺少有效角色的使用者訊息時，現在不會再直接退出。角色是用來標示訊息身分與用途的欄位；以前這個欄位無效就會讓整個工作階段結束，現在它會留在可繼續使用的狀態。後續訊息仍可交給同一個遠端工作階段處理，不必因單一欄位出錯而重新建立它。⟦像錄音室裡一條音軌的標籤填錯，音控會單獨挑出那條音軌處理，不會把整場錄音關掉。⟧
body.en: A remote session no longer exits when it receives a user message from a client without a valid role. A role is the field that identifies a message's identity and purpose; before, an invalid value could end the whole session, while it now remains usable. Later messages can still go to the same remote session instead of requiring a new one because of a single bad field. ⟦Like a recording studio where one track has the wrong label: the sound engineer isolates that track instead of shutting down the whole recording.⟧

items.original: Fixed remote sessions exiting when a client delivered a user message without a valid role

title.zh-TW: 遠端工作階段不再繼承啟動終端機的工作階段環境變數
title.en: Remote sessions no longer inherit environment variables from the launching shell

body.zh-TW: 透過 `claude remote-control` 新建的遠端工作階段，現在不再繼承啟動指令的 shell 工作階段環境變數。先前這些變數會從發起終端機帶入新工作階段，可能影響遠端環境；如今已被隔離。因此啟動新工作階段時，來源 shell 的工作階段設定不會混進遠端環境。⟦像把新租客的房門鑰匙和前一位住戶的抽屜分開交接，新房間不會自動帶著舊住戶的私人物品。⟧
body.en: New remote sessions started by `claude remote-control` no longer inherit session-scoped environment variables from the launching shell. They are now isolated instead of being carried into the remote environment. ⟦Like handing a new tenant the door key separately from the previous tenant’s drawers.⟧

items.original: Fixed Remote Control sessions started by `claude remote-control` inheriting session-scoped environment variables from the launching shell

title.zh-TW: 遠端工作階段當機後，下次傳訊即可重新使用
title.en: Crashed Remote Control sessions can be reused on the next message

body.zh-TW: 遠端工作階段的處理程序當機後，過去必須重新啟動 `claude remote-control` 才可使用。現在你下一次傳送訊息時，它會重新初始化並可再次使用，不必先手動重啟指令。這個改變在你下一次傳送訊息時發生，無須先額外執行重啟步驟。原本必須手動重啟才能恢復的步驟已不需要。⟦壞掉的自動販賣機不再一直掛著故障牌；下一位顧客投幣時，它會重新啟動。⟧
body.en: After a Remote Control session process crashes, it used to stay unavailable until `claude remote-control` was restarted. Now, the next message can reinitialize and reuse it. ⟦A broken vending machine restarts when the next customer inserts a coin instead of staying out of order.⟧

items.original: Fixed a Remote Control session whose process crashed staying unavailable until `claude remote-control` was restarted; it can now be reused when you next message it

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳訊拒收主動通報，信箱額滿不再無聲丟信
title.en: Cross-session messaging notifies senders on refused deliveries and dropped inboxes

body.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳訊時的狀態回饋更加透明。⟦像演唱會的點歌系統：若表演者關閉點歌、每人可點的歌已達限制，或待播歌單已到上限，點歌螢幕會立刻告訴點歌人失敗，不會讓他以為歌曲已排進去。⟧在本機多個工作階段互相發送訊息時，若接收端設定了 `{"crossSessionInbound": "refuse"}` 來拒收外來訊息，系統現在會明確向發送端回報已拒絕，不再假裝成功送達。同樣地，若接收端的收件匣因為達到傳輸速率限制或佇列已滿而丟棄訊息，也會主動通知發送端，避免訊息無聲無息地蒸發。
body.en: Cross-session messaging now provides direct feedback when messages cannot be delivered. ⟦Like a concert song-request system: if the performer has stopped taking requests, a person's request limit is reached, or the upcoming playlist is full, its screen immediately tells the requester it failed instead of leaving them to think the song was queued.⟧ When sending messages to a local session that rejects incoming chats via `{"crossSessionInbound": "refuse"}`, the sender now receives a clear "refused" status instead of a deceptive success report. Likewise, if a target inbox drops messages due to rate limits or a full queue, your active session is notified immediately instead of messages vanishing silently.

items.original:
Cross-session messaging: sending to a session on this machine that refuses inbound messages (e.g. `crossSessionInbound: "refuse"`) now reports "refused" to the sender instead of a silent success
Cross-session messaging: a session whose inbox drops your messages (rate limit or full queue) now tells your session, instead of the messages vanishing silently

title.zh-TW: 支援遠端尋找代理夥伴，背景預熱成員不再提前曝光
title.en: Multi-agent tools reach Remote Control peers and hide unassigned standby workers

body.zh-TW: 多代理協同合作與尋找夥伴的功能現在更加完善。過去在透過 `claude remote-control` 伺服器模式或桌面版與 IDE 運行的工作階段中，執行 `ListAgents` 或 `SendMessage` 工具時常會誤報遠端遙控未連線；現在已能正確列出並連繫夥伴代理。同時，代理檢視畫面為了加速下一個背景工作階段而預先熱身的閒置 worker，不再提早暴露在清單中，只有在真正有任務認領它時才會正式出現在名單上。⟦這如同劇團後台管理，隨時能呼叫遠端夥伴，而剛準備好的待命替補人員，則會在正式指派上台時才列入演出名冊。⟧
body.en: Multi-agent collaboration tools can now discover and communicate with peers across environments. Running `ListAgents` or `SendMessage` inside sessions hosted by `claude remote-control` server mode, Desktop, or IDE hosts previously failed with "Remote Control is not connected"; they can now locate and message remote peers reliably. Additionally, idle workers pre-warmed in the background to speed up your next session are no longer prematurely listed, appearing only after a task officially claims them. ⟦Like a theater roster that lets stage directors call remote cast members anytime, while keeping standby understudies hidden until they are formally assigned a role.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `ListAgents`/`SendMessage` reporting "Remote Control is not connected" in sessions run by `claude remote-control` (server mode) or Desktop/IDE hosts; they now list and reach Remote Control peers
Fixed `ListAgents` and `SendMessage` exposing the idle worker that the agent view pre-warms for your next background session; it now appears only once a task claims it

title.zh-TW: 提示詞建議維持生效至額度用盡，快取自然過期不跳警示
title.en: Prompt suggestions stay active near usage limits and expired cache warnings are suppressed

body.zh-TW: 提示詞建議與快取狀態的判斷邏輯變得更加準確。當你啟用環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=true` 時，過去只要帳號的使用量接近上限但尚未超額，提示詞自動建議就會提早關閉；現在只要未真正超額，建議功能就會持續開啟。另一方面，在使用 `/model` 切換模型或 `/effort` 調整思考深度時，若先前的 prompt 快取（cache，把先前處理過的上下文暫存起來直接用）本來就已經自然過期，系統不會再跳出不必要的快取未命中警示。⟦這如同水壺水位接近上限但未溢出就不會亂響警報，茶包依時間自然泡開也不會被誤報成異常。⟧
body.en: Prompt suggestions and cache status warnings now reflect exact account and cache states. If you set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=true`, suggestions previously shut off prematurely when your account approached its usage limit; they now remain active until the quota is genuinely reached. Meanwhile, switching models with `/model` or tweaking reasoning depth with `/effort` will no longer display false cache-miss warnings when prompt caches had simply expired on their own schedule. ⟦Like a kettle that refrains from sounding an alarm while water levels remain safely within bounds, without flagging a tea bag that steeped to completion as a defect.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=true` not keeping prompt suggestions on when your account is near, but not over, its usage limit
Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache-miss warning appearing when the prompt cache had already expired

title.zh-TW: 內建 claude-api 技能升級，支援沙盒網域白名單與記憶庫

On self-hosted sandboxes, agents can now configure allowed domains for web searching and web fetching, giving you granular control over external site access. Sandboxes also introduce memory stores, allowing managed agents to persist and retrieve long-term state securely within their private sandboxed environments. ⟦Like equipping a research lab with an approved network directory and a dedicated filing cabinet to control outbound lookups while preserving findings locally.⟧

title.zh-TW: 修復 LLM 閘道與自訂網址連線，提示詞快取正常重用
title.en: Prompt caching restored for LLM gateways and custom base URLs

body.zh-TW: ⟦像透過企業收發室代轉公文，收發窗口現在會妥善重用上次留存的複本，不再每次轉發都把厚厚的前情提要全部重印一次。⟧使用 LLM 閘道（LLM gateway，集中管理模型請求的中繼服務）或自訂基礎網址的工作階段，提示詞快取現在已恢復正常。過去這類工作階段的快取（cache，把先前處理過的文字暫存起來直接用）功能會失效，導致每次對話都得重新計算重複的前文。現在能順暢重用已暫存的內容，替每一次請求省下重複解析的時間與成本。
body.en: ⟦It is like a corporate mailroom reusing archived document copies instead of photocopying the entire thick dossier for every forwarded parcel.⟧Prompt caching is now fully functional for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL. Previously, routing your traffic through an intermediate gateway or custom endpoint broke prompt cache reuse, forcing subsequent API turns to re-process identical prompt prefixes from scratch. That cache invalidation issue has now been resolved, allowing sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL to save tokens and latency on repeated context.

title.zh-TW: 內建 Concise 精簡輸出風格，直出成果不講廢話
title.en: Built-in "Concise" output style leads with results and skips narration

body.zh-TW: 如果你討厭 AI 每次回話都先講一大串客套前言或碎碎念的工作進度，現在有了更乾淨俐落的回答方式。新版本在設定中加入了內建的「Concise」輸出風格。開啟後，Claude 會直接先給出具體結果，並省略開頭的前言寒暄與多餘的過程旁白，但背後的分析與執行工作依然一樣徹底仔細。想切換這個風格，只要在終端機輸入 `/config` 指令，並在「Output style」選項下選取「Concise」即可。⟦像找資深師傅維修設備，他默默把所有零件仔細檢修完成，接著直接把成果交到你手上，省去每做一步就要在旁邊逐一解說的冗長對話。⟧
body.en: You can now choose a cleaner, to-the-point response style if you prefer answers without filler commentary. This update adds a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads directly with concrete results while skipping preamble greetings and step-by-step narration, without compromising the thoroughness of the underlying work. To switch to this mode, run `/config` and select "Concise" under the "Output style" menu. ⟦It is like a seasoned repair technician who thoroughly inspects and fixes every component in silence, then hands you the completed work directly without narrating every turn of the wrench.⟧

items.original: Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.

entries: Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable: sets the model new sessions start on, while a `/model` pick still overrides it and persists across restarts (unlike `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`)

Fixed clipboard copy, background housekeeping, background sessions, and local MCP logs breaking after the directory a session had switched into was removed (since 2.1.229)
Fixed the fullscreen renderer failing permanently after a single failed start: it now falls back to the classic renderer instead of exiting on every subsequent launch
Fixed the `/model` picker rendering taller than the terminal: it now shows only as many models as fit the window, with the rest reachable by scrolling
Fixed `SendMessage` calls being rejected when a malformed closing tag left the message text inside the summary field
Fixed unhandled promise rejections when a subprocess fails to start, for example `powershell.exe` on WSL with Windows interop disabled (regression in 2.1.234)
Fixed fullscreen mode sometimes not showing a newly sent message until the next update after the terminal was resized
Fixed a blank band that could remain above the prompt after clearing a multi-line prompt, and panes not repainting after resizing the terminal away and back, in fullscreen mode
Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt sometimes not appearing at startup while still capturing the first keypress as approval
Fixed terminal tab titles jumping in tmux (iTerm tmux integration): the title is now written only when its text changes instead of animating every 960ms
Fixed an unclear error when the cloud environments list came back empty or malformed
Fixed the Fable 5 first-time usage-credits prompt auto-selecting the fallback model after 60 seconds with no answer when using Remote Control
Fixed spinner tips never appearing, with a repeated background error, when the cached guest-pass reward in `~/.claude.json` was malformed
Fixed skills hot-reload in SDK/VS Code sessions raising an error on every skills change after the session's working directory was deleted (2.1.229+)
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions released on idle, retire, or startup timeout occasionally resuming on another runner before the post-session hook had finished
Fixed the Clawd mascot's eyes and feet rendering unevenly in iTerm2 at some font sizes
Fixed occasional runaway session recaps: recap text (automatic and `/recap`) is now capped at 400 characters, cut at a word boundary
Improved startup performance: the session counter is now written in the background
Improved auto mode: `Monitor` allow rules are now set aside while auto mode is active, so Monitor commands are reviewed the same way Bash commands are
Improved auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled: the classifier now uses the same defaults as on the Claude API, including severity-scored classification
Improved auto mode: the git status check can no longer be fooled by a repo's `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` setting into reporting a clean tree
Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list
`/goal`: an idle session whose goal is parked behind long-running background work now checks in automatically after 30 minutes (then 1h, 2h) instead of waiting for you to return
`/usage` now shows the usage-credits spend row for Team and Enterprise members, and shows a capped row at 0% before anything is spent
SIGTERM in print/SDK mode no longer records an interrupted turn or synthetic tool denials before exiting; running commands are still terminated and the process still exits with code 143
Pressing Enter on a slash-command typo or a command unavailable in this session now reports it instead of running the closest fuzzy match; prefixes and aliases still run
Remote Control now marks a session offline within seconds when the CLI exits or its terminal closes
`SendMessage` now refuses further messages to a session up front once a rapid burst would exceed what that session's inbox accepts, instead of reporting them sent while they were dropped
Aligned the session title chip on the prompt border with the footer's right edge
Right-aligned footer items (goal indicator, session state, background agent status) and truncated notices now share a consistent right margin with the rest of the prompt area
[VSCode] Added screen reader support for the transcript: live announcements for replies, permission requests, errors, and status changes, plus per-turn heading navigation

title.zh-TW: 新增預設模型環境變數，手動挑選仍可在重啟後保留
title.en: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL sets session defaults while preserving /model picks

body.zh-TW:
⟦這像收音機的開機預設電台，每次打開自動轉到預設頻率，但只要你旋轉按鈕切換頻道，新頻道就會保留下來，不會一關機就強制還原。⟧ 新增的 `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` 環境變數（開程式前先給它的設定值）。它可指定新工作階段（session）預設啟動的模型。若使用 zsh，請把下列內容加到家目錄的 `~/.zshrc`，再開新終端機後啟動 Claude Code：
```
export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL=sonnet
```
`sonnet` 就是要填入的預設模型別名；想用 Opus 可改填 `opus`，也可填可用模型的完整名稱。對話中用 `/model` 另選模型時，手動選擇仍會覆蓋預設並在重啟後保留；會鎖死模型的 `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` 則不會。
body.en:
⟦Like a radio with a favorite preset that powers on to your station, yet lets you tune to another channel and remembers it after a reboot.⟧ The new `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable (a value supplied before the program starts) sets the model for new sessions. With zsh, add this to `~/.zshrc` in your home directory, then open a new terminal before starting Claude Code:
```
export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL=sonnet
```
`sonnet` is the default-model alias to enter; use `opus` for Opus, or a full supported model name. A `/model` selection during a conversation still overrides the default and persists after restarts, unlike the model-locking `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`.

items.original: Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable: sets the model new sessions start on, while a `/model` pick still overrides it and persists across restarts (unlike `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`)

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息新增閒置通知，無須輪詢即可掌握進度
title.en: SendMessage adds notify_when_idle for one-shot cross-session notices

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 與 Linux 上跨工作階段（session）傳送訊息時，`SendMessage` 工具現在新增了 `notify_when_idle` 參數。當你在本機同時開了多個 Claude Code 視窗，你可以透過這個參數請求另一個工作階段在下次進入閒置狀態時，主動回傳一次通知。這項機制屬於主動啟用且為單次發送，呼叫端完全不需要寫迴圈持續輪詢（polling）等待。⟦像請隔壁辦公室的同事在忙完手邊工作時敲門提醒一聲，你不必每隔幾分鐘就探頭查看他的進度。⟧
body.en: Cross-session `SendMessage` on macOS and Linux now includes a `notify_when_idle` option. When you run multiple Claude Code sessions on the same machine, one session can ask another to send a single notice the next time it becomes idle. It is an opt-in, one-shot mechanism that eliminates the need to poll the target session in a busy loop. ⟦Like asking a coworker in the next office to knock on your door when they finish, saving you from peeking into their room every few minutes.⟧

items.original: Added `notify_when_idle` to cross-session `SendMessage`: ask another Claude Code session on this machine to send one notice when it next goes idle — opt-in, one-shot, no polling (macOS and Linux)

title.zh-TW: macOS 沙盒嚴防機密外洩，萬用字元拒讀規則更嚴謹
title.en: macOS sandbox enforces wildcard read-deny rules and blocks rename bypasses

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好比在金庫的准入許可中貼上禁止翻閱帳冊的特別禁令，即使訪客獲准進入整個資料室、或者把帳冊裝進新皮套，禁令依然直接生效且涵蓋整個檔案夾。⟧ 在 macOS 的沙盒（sandbox）環境中，萬用字元讀取拒絕規則現在具備更高優先權。例如比對到 `**/.env` 的規則，即使該路徑位於原本允許讀取的目錄範圍內，拒絕規則依然優先適用；同時，規則能完整涵蓋符合條件的目錄內所有檔案，且無法透過將被拒絕的檔案重新命名來規避讀取限制。
body.en: ⟦Like a vault pass marked with a strict restriction against reading ledgers: even if a guest is allowed into the archive room or renames the denied file, the denial remains absolute.⟧ On macOS, sandbox wildcard read-deny rules (such as `**/.env`) now take precedence inside allowed read regions. They cover the full contents of matched directories, and access cannot be bypassed simply by renaming the denied file.

items.original: Sandbox: on macOS, wildcard read-deny rules (e.g. `**/.env`) now take precedence inside allowed read regions, cover matched directories' contents, and can't be bypassed by renaming the denied file

title.zh-TW: 工作資料夾遭外部刪除時，剪貼簿與背景任務不再損毀
title.en: Session utilities, MCP logs, and skills hot-reload survive deleted working directories

body.zh-TW: 當工作階段（session）切換進入的資料夾被外部刪除後，各項背景與周邊功能不再整批壞掉。自 2.1.229 版本以來，一旦所在目錄消失，剪貼簿複製、背景日常維護、背景工作階段與本機 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）日誌都會損毀；SDK 與 VS Code 工作階段在技能變更時也會反覆報錯。現在系統已妥善處理目錄遺失的狀況，所有功能均能穩定維持運作。⟦如同臨時辦公桌被撤走時，工作人員手上的記事本、對講機與工具箱依然能正常運作，不會當場癱瘓。⟧
body.en: Background tasks and utilities no longer break when a session's directory is deleted from underneath it. Since 2.1.229, removing the active working directory broke clipboard copying, background housekeeping, background sessions, and local MCP (Model Context Protocol) logs, while triggering errors on every skill change in SDK and VS Code sessions. The runtime now handles missing working directories smoothly without failing. ⟦Like a worker whose folding table is packed away: their clipboard, walkie-talkie, and toolbelt continue to function normally without a hitch.⟧

items.original:
Fixed clipboard copy, background housekeeping, background sessions, and local MCP logs breaking after the directory a session had switched into was removed (since 2.1.229)
Fixed skills hot-reload in SDK/VS Code sessions raising an error on every skills change after the session's working directory was deleted (2.1.229+)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕渲染器啟動失敗時，自動退回傳統渲染模式
title.en: Fullscreen renderer falls back to classic mode if startup fails

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕渲染器現在具備自我修復與備援（fallback）機制。過去如果全螢幕渲染器在啟動時遭遇單一次失敗，整個設定便會陷入永久損毀狀態，導致後續每次啟動 Claude Code 時都會直接崩潰退出。現在系統遇到全螢幕渲染啟動失敗時，會主動退回至穩定的傳統渲染器，確保終端機依然能順利開啟並供你正常操作。⟦像舞台上的數位投影特效機若故障，燈光系統會自動切換為傳統聚光燈繼續照明，不會讓整個劇場直接熄燈散場。⟧
body.en: The fullscreen renderer now recovers gracefully from startup failures. Previously, if the fullscreen renderer failed to initialize a single time, the application became permanently broken and crashed on every subsequent launch. It now falls back to the classic terminal renderer instead of exiting, keeping your session operational. ⟦Like a stage projector failing to boot: the lighting system immediately switches back to classic spotlights so the show goes on.⟧

items.original: Fixed the fullscreen renderer failing permanently after a single failed start: it now falls back to the classic renderer instead of exiting on every subsequent launch

title.zh-TW: 模型挑選選單支援滾動瀏覽，且只醒目標示最新釋出型號
title.en: /model picker scrolls within terminal bounds and highlights only newest release

body.zh-TW: ⟦走進冰淇淋店看數位菜單，螢幕若放不下全部口味，會自動切成上下捲動頁面，並只在剛上市的當季新品旁標上醒目的星號，不再隨意圈選其他舊品項。⟧ 輸入 `/model` 挑選模型時，選單的高度現在會自動符合終端機視窗大小。當清單內容超出視窗高度時，系統只會顯示容得下的項目，其餘模型可透過滾動查看；同時，介面改為僅醒目標示最新釋出的模型名稱，讓視覺焦點明確落在最新版本上。
body.en: ⟦Like a digital menu board in a dessert parlor that scrolls smoothly when items exceed screen height, while highlighting only the single newest flavor of the season.⟧ The `/model` picker now fits cleanly inside your terminal window. If the list of available models is taller than the terminal, it renders only what fits and lets you scroll through the rest. Furthermore, the highlight style is now reserved exclusively for the newest model release rather than arbitrary items.

items.original:
Fixed the `/model` picker rendering taller than the terminal: it now shows only as many models as fit the window, with the rest reachable by scrolling
Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list

title.zh-TW: 修正跨工作階段訊息解析，標籤異常不再導致訊息遭拒
title.en: SendMessage fixes malformed closing tags causing summary text rejections

body.zh-TW: 跨工作階段（session）傳送訊息時，格式解析變得更具容錯能力。以往在使用 `SendMessage` 工具時，如果訊息內容中含有格式錯誤的閉合標籤，系統解析時會不小心把整段訊息文字誤塞進摘要（summary）欄位中，進而導致整筆發送請求被後端直接拒絕。現在這項解析邏輯已修正完畢。⟦就像診所掛號時，表單的結尾欄位寫壞了，櫃檯仍會把病況說明留在說明欄，而不會誤塞進摘要欄後拒絕掛號。⟧
body.en: Cross-session messaging now parses malformed payload tags reliably. Previously, when calling `SendMessage`, a broken closing tag could accidentally displace the message body into the summary parameter, causing the request to be rejected. The parser now isolates the text correctly regardless of imperfect tag formatting. ⟦Like a clinic registration desk that keeps a patient's description in the description field despite a malformed closing label, instead of putting it in the summary box and rejecting the registration.⟧

items.original: Fixed `SendMessage` calls being rejected when a malformed closing tag left the message text inside the summary field

title.zh-TW: 子行程啟動失敗妥善攔截，避免 WSL 環境直接崩潰
title.en: Subprocess startup failures are handled cleanly without unhandled rejections

body.zh-TW: ⟦好比派外送員出門時如果發現機車發不動，調度台會妥善處理這次派工失敗，不會讓整個調度中心警報大作。⟧ 當外部子行程（subprocess）無法啟動時，系統現在能優雅地捕捉錯誤。在 2.1.234 版本中，如果在關閉 Windows 互通性的 WSL（Windows 子系統）環境中嘗試啟動 `powershell.exe`，系統會因為未妥善處理非同步拒絕而直接崩潰；現在這類錯誤會被妥善捕捉與處理。
body.en: ⟦Like a delivery dispatcher handling a scooter that failed to start calmly, rather than letting the entire dispatch office crash in confusion.⟧ Subprocess startup failures no longer trigger unhandled promise rejections. In version 2.1.234, trying to launch a command like `powershell.exe` on WSL with Windows interop disabled caused unhandled runtime crashes. The process manager now catches and handles these startup errors cleanly.

items.original: Fixed unhandled promise rejections when a subprocess fails to start, for example `powershell.exe` on WSL with Windows interop disabled (regression in 2.1.234)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕視窗縮放重繪修復，多行輸入清除不再殘留白邊
title.en: Fullscreen mode fixes delayed messages, prompt blank bands, and pane repainting

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕模式下的畫面重繪與文字顯示迎來多項細節修正。過去在縮放終端機視窗大小後，新送出的訊息有時會卡住，直到下一次畫面更新才突然冒出來；清除多行提示詞時，輸入框上方也常留下一道空白帶；且將視窗縮小後再放大時，各面板畫面更會出現無法重繪的缺塊。現在這些介面重繪問題已全數修復。⟦如同控制室的單一看板：縮放後的新通知會立刻亮起，清除多行輸入後不留空白帶，面板重新放大時各區也會完整顯示。⟧
body.en: Fullscreen mode received several screen-drawing and layout fixes. Resizing the terminal window sometimes caused newly submitted messages to remain invisible until the subsequent UI tick. In addition, clearing multi-line prompts could leave an empty blank band above the input area, and resizing panes away and back left views unpainted. These visual rendering issues have all been resolved. ⟦Like a clean blackboard wiping down without stray chalk marks, updating text instantly without lag when the frame is adjusted.⟧

items.original:
Fixed fullscreen mode sometimes not showing a newly sent message until the next update after the terminal was resized
Fixed a blank band that could remain above the prompt after clearing a multi-line prompt, and panes not repainting after resizing the terminal away and back, in fullscreen mode

title.zh-TW: 受管設定啟動審查確實顯示，防止首個按鍵誤當核准
title.en: Managed-settings prompt ensures visibility before capturing approval keystrokes

body.zh-TW: ⟦如同辦理重要合約時，櫃檯必須先把同意書端到你眼前確認，不能把文件藏在桌下、卻將你走進門按的第一個電鈴當成簽字同意。⟧ 系統修復了受管設定（managed settings，由企業或管理者統一推送的設定檔）在啟動時的嚴重安全風險。過去在特定狀況下，啟動時的設定核准視窗未能正常顯示在畫面上，卻依然偷偷將使用者的第一次按鍵當成同意審查，造成誤按核准；現在對話框必定會確實顯示後才接收輸入。
body.en: ⟦Like a formal contract where the clerk must place the document directly in front of you, rather than keeping it hidden while treating your doorbell press as a signature.⟧ A dangerous security issue with managed settings prompts has been fixed. Previously, the startup prompt asking for approval of managed configurations could fail to display on screen while still recording your very first keystroke as consent. The prompt now reliably renders before processing user input.

items.original: Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt sometimes not appearing at startup while still capturing the first keypress as approval

title.zh-TW: tmux 分頁標題不再頻繁跳動，文字有變更才寫入更新
title.en: tmux tab titles stop jumping by updating only when text actually changes

body.zh-TW: 在 tmux（特別是搭配 iTerm 的 tmux 整合模式）中執行時，分頁標題不再持續抖動。過去系統每隔 960 毫秒就會進行一次動畫式的標題重寫，導致終端機分頁上的文字不斷閃爍跳動，干擾視覺專注；現在系統改為僅在標題文字真正發生改變時才執行寫入操作，保持分頁列的穩定與清爽。⟦這好比會議室門口的電子名牌，只有在更換會議主題時才刷新字樣，不再每秒閃爍一次背光。⟧
body.en: Terminal tab titles inside tmux (especially via iTerm tmux integration) no longer jump jittery across updates. The title string used to be rewritten continuously on a 960ms animation loop, creating visible flicker on the tab bar. It is now written only when the title text itself changes. ⟦Like a meeting room door display that updates only when the title text changes, rather than flickering its backlight every second.⟧

items.original: Fixed terminal tab titles jumping in tmux (iTerm tmux integration): the title is now written only when its text changes instead of animating every 960ms

title.zh-TW: 雲端環境清單為空或損毀時，提供清楚的錯誤原因說明
title.en: Clear errors when cloud environments list is empty or malformed

body.zh-TW: 當你存取雲端環境時，遇到清單異常不再摸不著頭緒。以往如果從遠端取回的雲端環境清單為空白，或者回傳的資料結構格式損毀，系統只會跳出語意模糊、難以排查的錯誤代碼；現在錯誤訊息已大幅改善，會清楚指明清單為空或格式不符的具體原因，方便你即時排查網路或遠端設定問題。⟦像大樓樓層導覽螢幕會清楚寫出「目前沒有登錄租戶」或「導覽資料格式錯誤」，而不是只丟出難懂的故障代碼。⟧
body.en: Fetching cloud environments now returns descriptive diagnostics if the response is empty or damaged. Previously, when the cloud environment endpoint returned an empty list or malformed data, the CLI presented an opaque, unhelpful error message. It now explains the failure clearly so you can diagnose configuration issues quickly. ⟦Like a building directory that clearly says "no tenants listed" or "directory data is malformed", rather than displaying an inscrutable failure code.⟧

items.original: Fixed an unclear error when the cloud environments list came back empty or malformed

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控下額度提示逾時，不再擅自替你選取備援模型
title.en: Remote Control stops auto-selecting fallback models on Fable 5 prompt timeout

body.zh-TW: ⟦像在餐廳點餐時店員詢問是否改點另一道備選餐點，若你剛好離座洗手，店家應當靜候你回來確認，而不該在一分鐘後擅自替你更換餐點。⟧ 使用遠端遙控（Remote Control）時，額度提示不再逾時亂選。針對 Fable 5 的首次使用額度確認對話框，過去若等了 60 秒仍未收到使用者回應，系統會自動套用備援（fallback）模型；現在已移除這項自動選擇，靜候你的決定。
body.en: ⟦Like a dining order where the waiter waits for you to return to the table, rather than automatically switching to a fallback dish after 60 seconds of absence.⟧ When using Remote Control, the initial usage-credits confirmation prompt for Fable 5 no longer automatically picks a fallback model after 60 seconds of inactivity. It now remains open until you explicitly respond.

items.original: Fixed the Fable 5 first-time usage-credits prompt auto-selecting the fallback model after 60 seconds with no answer when using Remote Control

title.zh-TW: 訪客通行證快取損毀時，修復背景錯誤並恢復提示顯示
title.en: Spinner tips and background loops recover from malformed guest-pass cache

body.zh-TW: 在等待 Claude 運算時，旋轉指示器旁的小提示（spinner tips）現在能穩定顯示。以前如果個人目錄設定檔 `~/.claude.json` 中快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）的訪客通行證獎勵資料格式損毀，系統會在背景不斷陷入重複報錯的迴圈，導致轉圈等待時的小提示完全無法跳出來。現在系統會妥善防護並略過格式錯誤的快取資料。⟦猶如導航程式讀到損毀的已存路線時，會略過那筆資料並照常顯示下一步提示，不再反覆跳出錯誤。⟧
body.en: Spinner tips now appear reliably while waiting for responses. Previously, if the cached guest-pass reward in `~/.claude.json` was malformed, the system entered a repeated background error loop and failed to render loading tips completely. The cache reader now handles corrupted data gracefully. ⟦Like a navigation app that skips a corrupted saved route and keeps showing the next instruction instead of repeatedly surfacing an error.⟧

items.original: Fixed spinner tips never appearing, with a repeated background error, when the cached guest-pass reward in `~/.claude.json` was malformed

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器完成後置掛鉤後，才允許在其他節點恢復工作
title.en: Self-hosted runner sessions await post-session hooks before migrating

body.zh-TW: ⟦如同租車公司還車時，必須等前一位駕駛的車輛清潔與交車檢查徹底完成，系統才能把鑰匙交給下一位客人，避免兩邊撞期。⟧ 自架執行器（self-hosted runner）的工作階段調度更穩固了。工作階段可能因閒置、除役（retire）或啟動逾時而釋放。過去在此類情境下，後置掛鉤（post-session hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）可能還在收尾，系統卻偶爾已在另一個執行器上恢復該工作階段；現在必定會等待掛鉤完全結束才允許接續。
body.en: ⟦Like a car rental return where inspection and cleaning must finish completely before the keys are handed to the next driver, preventing overlapping handoffs.⟧ Self-hosted runner session lifecycle handling is now race-free. When a session is released due to idle, retire, or startup timeout, it used to occasionally resume on a different runner before its post-session hook finished executing. The coordinator now strictly awaits hook completion before migrating the session.

items.original: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions released on idle, retire, or startup timeout occasionally resuming on another runner before the post-session hook had finished

title.zh-TW: iTerm2 特定字型下 Clawd 吉祥物排版修復，五官不再歪斜
title.en: Clawd mascot eyes and feet align neatly across all iTerm2 font sizes

body.zh-TW: 在 iTerm2 終端機中看見的 Clawd 吉祥物變得更加工整可愛。過去在某些特定的字型與字級大小設定下，終端機渲染文字圖形時會產生微小字元寬度偏差，導致 Clawd 的眼睛左右不對稱、雙腳高度參差不齊；這次更新微調了字元輸出對齊方式，確保在各種字型大小下都能呈現端正勻稱的吉祥物樣貌。⟦宛如繪圖軟體微調了像素網格對齊，讓小寵物的五官與腳爪在任何螢幕縮放下都工整對稱。⟧
body.en: The Clawd mascot in iTerm2 now displays with consistent proportions. At certain terminal font sizes, character cell measurement differences caused Clawd's ASCII eyes and feet to render misaligned and lopsided. Spacing has been adjusted so the mascot appears cleanly balanced across different font configurations. ⟦Like snapping pixel art to an exact grid so an illustrated mascot's eyes and paws stay symmetrical at any zoom level.⟧

items.original: Fixed the Clawd mascot's eyes and feet rendering unevenly in iTerm2 at some font sizes

title.zh-TW: 工作階段摘要設定 400 字上限，單字邊界截斷防膨脹
title.en: Session recaps capped at 400 characters and trimmed at word boundaries

body.zh-TW: ⟦像書籍封底的內容簡介設有嚴格的字數限制，超過篇幅時會在最後一個完整單詞處乾淨收尾，不再讓冗長文字溢出封面。⟧ 工作階段（session）的摘要功能不再無限膨脹。過去無論是系統自動產生的摘要，還是手動輸入 `/recap` 產生的回顧，偶爾會失控生成落落長的冗長篇幅；現在摘要文字被嚴格限制在最多 400 個字元內，並在單字邊界截斷，不從單字中間切開。
body.en: ⟦Like a book jacket blurb with a strict character limit that stops at the end of a complete word rather than spilling over the cover.⟧ Session recaps will no longer run away with endless text. Both automatic recaps and manual `/recap` outputs are now capped at a maximum of 400 characters, neatly truncated at a clean word boundary so that sentences do not cut off mid-word.

items.original: Fixed occasional runaway session recaps: recap text (automatic and `/recap`) is now capped at 400 characters, cut at a word boundary

title.zh-TW: 工作階段計數器改由背景寫入，縮短啟動等待時間
title.en: Session counter writes in background to boost startup performance

body.zh-TW: 每次啟動 Claude Code 時的速度變得更加輕快。過去在啟動階段，系統會先停在前台等待工作階段計數器（session counter）完成磁碟寫入，稍微拖慢了進入對話畫面的時間；現在這項寫入作業已全面移至背景非同步執行，不再阻礙主流程的啟動作業。⟦就像超市入口讓顧客直接進門，門邊的人流計數器則在背景累加人數，不必等店員先寫完紀錄才放行。⟧
body.en: Launching Claude Code is now faster and more responsive. Previously, the CLI blocked startup while waiting to record the session counter to disk. This write operation is now handled in the background, allowing the prompt interface to open without unnecessary disk I/O delay. ⟦Like a supermarket that lets shoppers enter while a doorway counter increments visitor totals in the background, instead of holding the door until a clerk records each arrival.⟧

items.original: Improved startup performance: the session counter is now written in the background

title.zh-TW: 自動模式暫存 Monitor 放行規則，指令審查更嚴謹安全
title.en: Auto mode reviews Monitor commands like Bash by shelving allow rules

body.zh-TW: ⟦像機場開啟全面自動安檢警戒時，即使平時持有免檢通行證的內部維護人員，隨身裝備也必須一律放進 X 光機接受完整掃描。⟧ 自動模式（auto mode，讓 Claude 不逐一問你就自己執行的模式）的安全防護進一步提升。在自動模式運作期間，原本設定的 `Monitor` 允許規則會被暫時擱置，所有監控指令將與一般 Bash 指令一視同仁，接受相同標準的安全審查，避免指令繞過防護。
body.en: ⟦Like an airport switching to full automated security where even staff with bypass badges must put their bags through the X-ray machine.⟧ Auto mode security has been strengthened. When auto mode is active, existing `Monitor` allow rules are temporarily set aside, ensuring that Monitor commands undergo the exact same safety review as standard Bash commands.

items.original: Improved auto mode: `Monitor` allow rules are now set aside while auto mode is active, so Monitor commands are reviewed the same way Bash commands are

title.zh-TW: 雲端平台自動模式分類器標準統一，依嚴重程度精準評分
title.en: Auto mode classifier unifies severity scoring across all cloud platforms

body.zh-TW: 自動模式（auto mode，讓 Claude 不逐一問你就執行的模式）在各雲端平台看齊官方規格。在 Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry 以及停用遙測的環境中，系統分類器現在採用與官方 Claude API 完全相同的預設配置，包含依據嚴重程度進行評分（severity-scored）的判斷機制，確保風險判定一致且可靠。⟦如同教育主管機關讓每所學校都採用同一份評量標準，不會因為校區不同而換一套分級方式。⟧
body.en: Auto mode classification is now standardized across third-party cloud environments. On Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, and setups where telemetry is turned off, the auto mode classifier now adopts the exact same defaults used on the Claude API, including severity-scored safety classification. ⟦Like a school district using the same grading rubric at every campus, rather than changing standards based on location.⟧

items.original: Improved auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled: the classifier now uses the same defaults as on the Claude API, including severity-scored classification

title.zh-TW: 自動模式 Git 狀態檢查升級，無視隱藏未追蹤檔案設定
title.en: Auto mode git status check ignores showUntrackedFiles=no overrides

body.zh-TW: ⟦像倉庫盤點時即使設定檔勾選了「隱藏無條碼紙箱」，稽查員依然會徹底檢查庫房角落，絕不草率判定倉庫為完全淨空。⟧ 自動模式（auto mode）執行 Git 狀態檢查時更加嚴密。過去如果專案的 Git 設定中包含 `status.showUntrackedFiles=no`，系統會被該設定矇蔽，誤以為工作目錄沒有任何未追蹤檔案而回報乾淨狀態；現在系統已修正檢查邏輯，不再漏看任何未追蹤檔案。
body.en: ⟦Like an inventory audit where the auditor inspects all unlabelled boxes in the warehouse regardless of a setting telling the scanner to ignore untracked items.⟧ The git status check in auto mode is now impervious to repository overrides. Previously, a repo configured with `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` could fool the check into declaring a clean working tree. The inspector now inspects untracked files accurately regardless of local git configuration.

items.original: Improved auto mode: the git status check can no longer be fooled by a repo's `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` setting into reporting a clean tree

title.zh-TW: /goal 任務停泊於背景工作時，自動定時回報進度
title.en: /goal periodically checks in on sessions parked behind background tasks

body.zh-TW: ⟦如同把車輛送進保養廠大修時，專員會在 30 分鐘後、以及隨後每隔一段時間主動發簡訊回報進度，而不是等車主親自回廠詢問。⟧ 使用 `/goal` 指令設定長程目標時，若工作階段因為等待長時間運行的背景工作而進入閒置狀態，系統現在會在 30 分鐘後自動甦醒並進行進度檢查與回報，隨後依序在 1 小時與 2 小時再次檢查，不必等使用者手動切回視窗觸發。
body.en: ⟦Like a mechanic messaging you with progress updates after 30 minutes and at regular intervals during a lengthy repair, rather than waiting for you to call in.⟧ When a session running under `/goal` is parked waiting for long-running background tasks to complete, it now checks in automatically after 30 minutes (and subsequently at 1h and 2h marks) instead of sitting idle until you return.

items.original: `/goal`: an idle session whose goal is parked behind long-running background work now checks in automatically after 30 minutes (then 1h, 2h) instead of waiting for you to return

title.zh-TW: /usage 支援團隊額度花費列，未消費時清楚標記 0%
title.en: /usage displays usage-credits rows for Team and Enterprise plans

body.zh-TW: 查看額度消耗時，團隊方案的使用者現在能掌握更清楚的資訊。輸入 `/usage` 指令時，系統現在會為 Team 與 Enterprise 方案成員顯示專屬的使用額度（usage-credits）花費列；在尚未產生任何花費之前，該列會明確標示為 0% 的上限狀態，方便管理者與成員清楚了解當前的配額起點。⟦這好比公司發放專屬公務油卡時，儀表板一開始就清楚列出總額度與已使用 0% 的進度條，讓持卡人在出發前就心中有數。⟧
body.en: The `/usage` command now provides detailed credit consumption views for Team and Enterprise organization members. It displays a dedicated usage-credits row, which clearly shows a capped bar at 0% before any spending occurs, giving teams full clarity over their starting baseline. ⟦Like a corporate gas card dashboard displaying the full allowance along with a clean "0% spent" status before your first trip.⟧

items.original: `/usage` now shows the usage-credits spend row for Team and Enterprise members, and shows a capped row at 0% before anything is spent

title.zh-TW: print/SDK 模式接收 SIGTERM 乾淨結束，不留偽造拒絕紀錄
title.en: SIGTERM in print/SDK modes exits cleanly without synthetic tool denials

body.zh-TW: 在列印（print）或 SDK 模式下結束處理程序時，對話歷史不再殘留多餘的干擾紀錄。過去收到 `SIGTERM` 終止訊號時，系統會在歷史紀錄中寫入回合中斷與偽造的工具拒絕紀錄；現在系統結束時不再寫入這些多餘資訊，同時正在執行的指令依然會被正常終止，處理程序也維持以代碼 143 退出。⟦好比辦公室收到下班通知時員工直接關機離席，出勤簿上標記正常打卡下班，不會憑空補記一筆拒絕處理公文的違規紀錄。⟧
body.en: Terminating print or SDK sessions via `SIGTERM` now produces clean exit logs. The runtime no longer injects synthetic tool denials or interrupted-turn artifacts into the conversation transcript before shutting down. Active commands are still terminated properly, and the process exits with status code 143. ⟦Like clocking out at the end of the shift: your log shows a normal departure rather than claiming you refused to answer work requests.⟧

items.original: SIGTERM in print/SDK mode no longer records an interrupted turn or synthetic tool denials before exiting; running commands are still terminated and the process still exits with code 143

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令打錯時精確報錯，不再盲目執行模糊比對
title.en: Slash-command typos report errors directly instead of guessing fuzzy matches

body.zh-TW: ⟦像在電視遙控器輸入未知頻道號碼時，螢幕會提示查無此頻道，而不會自作主張跳轉到號碼相近的冷門節目。⟧ 輸入斜線指令時不再因為手滑而誤跑其他指令。過去若不小心打錯斜線指令，或輸入了當前工作階段（session）無法使用的指令並按下 Enter，系統會自動挑選最接近的模糊比對結果執行；現在系統會直接回報找不到該指令，不過正規的指令前綴與別名依然可以正常執行。
body.en: ⟦Like punching a typo into a TV remote: the television reports that the channel does not exist, rather than jumping into a random nearby channel.⟧ Typing a slash-command typo or invoking a command not available in the current session now cleanly displays an error on Enter, instead of executing the nearest fuzzy match. Legitimate command prefixes and registered aliases continue to execute as expected.

items.original: Pressing Enter on a slash-command typo or a command unavailable in this session now reports it instead of running the closest fuzzy match; prefixes and aliases still run

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控在終端機關閉後數秒內，迅速標記為離線狀態
title.en: Remote Control reflects offline status within seconds when CLI exits

body.zh-TW: 使用遠端遙控（Remote Control）管理對話時，線上狀態的同步變得更即時。當你在本機結束命令列介面（CLI）或直接關閉終端機視窗時，連線狀態會迅速更新。遠端系統現在會在數秒鐘之內將該工作階段（session）標記為離線，不再讓介面長時間停留在連線中的假象。⟦這就像通訊軟體在手機關機時，頭像旁的線上綠燈會在幾秒內轉為離線灰燈，不讓遠端的使用者誤以為對方仍在線上等待。⟧
body.en: Remote Control session status synchronizes much faster when your local client shuts down. Whenever the CLI exits or the terminal window is closed, connection status refreshes immediately. Remote Control now marks the session as offline within seconds instead of lingering as active. ⟦Like a messenger app turning your profile badge from green to grey within seconds of closing your laptop, preventing others from thinking you are still available.⟧

items.original: Remote Control now marks a session offline within seconds when the CLI exits or its terminal closes

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息超載時前端拒絕，不再假裝送出卻默默丟棄
title.en: SendMessage rejects inbox overflows up front instead of dropping them silently

body.zh-TW: 跨工作階段（session）傳送訊息時，資料收發的可靠度大幅提升。過去如果短時間內密集送出大量突發訊息，導致數量超出接收端收件匣所能承載的上限，系統會表面回報發送成功、背地裡卻把超出的訊息悄悄丟棄；現在 `SendMessage` 會在最前線直接拒絕超量的發送請求並回傳錯誤，讓你能即時掌握傳輸狀況。⟦像工廠的零件暫存架已滿時，管理員會先拒絕接收新零件，而不會先登記入庫再默默丟掉。⟧
body.en: Cross-session messaging now guarantees honest feedback when handling sudden bursts. Previously, when rapid bursts exceeded what a destination session's inbox could accommodate, `SendMessage` reported them as delivered even though messages were dropped. It now rejects excessive messages up front with an error so the caller can back off or retry. ⟦Like a factory parts rack that refuses a new part once it is full, rather than marking it stored and silently throwing it away.⟧

items.original: `SendMessage` now refuses further messages to a session up front once a rapid burst would exceed what that session's inbox accepts, instead of reporting them sent while they were dropped

title.zh-TW: 提示詞邊框標籤與頁尾右緣對齊，終端介面排版更工整
title.en: Prompt border title chips and right-aligned footer items align consistently

body.zh-TW: ⟦如同排版精良的雜誌頁面，頁首章節標籤、內文邊界與頁尾資訊全都沿著同一條垂直輔助線切齊，整體版面俐落清爽。⟧ 終端機輸入介面的排版細節更加協調。提示詞邊框上的工作階段標題標籤，現在與頁尾右側邊界精準對齊；同時，頁尾右側的各項狀態指標（包含目標指示器、工作階段狀態、背景代理狀態）以及文字截斷提示，也全部採用與提示詞主區域一致的右側邊界寬度。
body.en: ⟦Like a clean magazine layout where header tags, body margins, and footer notes all align with the same vertical grid line.⟧ The terminal prompt layout has been polished for visual consistency. The session title chip embedded on the prompt border now aligns with the footer's right edge. Furthermore, right-aligned footer items (such as the goal indicator, session state, and background agent status) and truncated notices share a uniform right margin with the prompt box.

items.original:
Aligned the session title chip on the prompt border with the footer's right edge
Right-aligned footer items (goal indicator, session state, background agent status) and truncated notices now share a consistent right margin with the rest of the prompt area

title.zh-TW: VS Code 支援螢幕報讀器，逐字稿朗讀與回合標題導覽
title.en: VS Code extension adds screen reader announcements and heading navigation

body.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件的無障礙支援迎來重大改進。現在逐字稿（transcript，完整對話歷史紀錄）具備更完善的朗讀能力。擴充套件全面支援螢幕報讀器（screen reader）。當 Claude 回覆訊息、跳出權限請求、發生錯誤或狀態改變時，系統都會提供即時語音朗讀通知。此外，報讀器使用者還能透過各對話回合標題快速跳轉導覽。⟦像能朗讀的文件閱讀器，會即時讀出新內容與提示，也讓你依章節標題跳到想聽的位置。⟧
body.en: The VS Code extension now provides full screen reader accessibility for the session transcript. Users receive live audible announcements for incoming replies, permission prompts, errors, and status changes. In addition, the transcript incorporates per-turn heading structures so assistive technology users can navigate swiftly from turn to turn. ⟦Like a document reader that announces new content and prompts live, while letting you jump to the spot you want by chapter heading.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added screen reader support for the transcript: live announcements for replies, permission requests, errors, and status changes, plus per-turn heading navigation

entries: Added an optional `spellcheck` setting that underlines misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using your installed `aspell`, `hunspell`, or `ispell`
Fixed whole-prompt-cache invalidation when a language server disconnected or reconnected mid-session
Fixed nested markdown list items misaligning at depth 3+ and added a hanging indent to wrapped list items in the terminal UI
Fixed prompt input highlights (slash commands, keywords, mentions) appearing shifted by one or more characters in some multi-line prompts
Fixed Shift+Tab inside the permission prompt's comment field approving the edit and granting session-wide edit permission instead of closing the field
Fixed the Agent tool advertising a general-purpose default in sessions where that agent is unavailable: an omitted `subagent_type` there now gets a clear error listing the available agents
Fixed notebook cell delete/replace approval dialogs silently omitting the existing cell content when the notebook or cell could not be read; the dialog now says why
Fixed slash commands run while Claude is responding showing HTML entities instead of the actual characters
Fixed the prompt footer not showing the "Update installed" restart notice after a background auto-update
Fixed the expanded task list (`ctrl+t`) always starting collapsed when resuming or relaunching into a session that still has open tasks
Improved memory and CPU usage while cloud sessions such as `/ultrareview` or `/autofix-pr` run in the background — their event streams are no longer re-scanned and re-rendered on every update
Improved permission dialogs: display text and "don't ask again" options now always match what a grant would cover, and "don't ask again" is withheld when contents cannot be fully displayed
